• Strong written English (C1+) and comfortable spoken English on a live call. You can write to an investor, a customer, and a vendor without sending the same email three times.

• You can turn a messy topic into a short document: situation, options, recommendation, next actions.

• You work comfortably in spreadsheets and can sanity-check costs and tradeoffs.

• You decide without full information, and you say so when you got it wrong.

• Discretion, because you will see everything, including what is not going well.

• Available 9am to 5pm US Pacific, Monday to Friday. I can flex the start to 8am if that suits your day better.

• Reliable internet with a backup plan, quality camera and headset, quiet workspace.

• Modern laptop with 24GB+ RAM.

This is probably not for you if

• You need tasks specified before you can start.

• You are looking for a strategy or advisory role.

• You would rather coordinate work than do it.

• You wait for approval on reversible decisions.

• You need your responsibilities to stay inside a defined box.

• You think AI output is finished work.

On AI
We are a slop-free startup.
AI makes output cheap, it has not made reviewing that output any cheaper. Handing us unfiltered, unreviewed, verbose AI output moves your work onto someone else’s desk. That will get you fired.
Use AI constantly, to take on more than one person could. Read everything before it leaves your hands.

Responsabilidades:
• Projects that do not belong to anyone yet, from framing through delivery.

• Hiring: sourcing, screening, scheduling, and keeping the pipeline honest.

• Contractors and artists, including scope, delivery dates, invoices, and follow-through.

• The operating cadence: what is tracked, what is overdue, what stopped moving without anyone noticing.

• Systems and SOPs for work that currently lives in my head.

• Investor outreach support: build the list, help send the emails, get the calls on the calendar.

• Whatever is on fire this month that nobody else can pick up.

What success looks like:

First 90 days. You have mapped what is in flight and what has stalled. I have stopped chasing status. You have taken at least two initiatives off me end to end.
Ongoing. You bring me decisions with a recommendation attached rather than problems. Fewer things need me personally each month.

• Early employee at a startup where everyone did everything.

• Someone who has already been a founder’s right hand.

• Managed complicated client projects end to end.

• Built an operations function from nothing.

Your title matters much less to me than what you actually owned. If you have made payroll, chased an unpaid invoice, or sat across from an angry client, say so.

postings.title: Product Manager (Ops)
postings.descriptionText:
• You can look at forty scattered requests and say which five matter, and defend the call when someone disagrees.

• 2+ years in product operations, as an associate or junior product manager, or in customer success or support at a software company.

• You are genuinely curious about users. You ask the second and third question, not just the first.

• Fluent written and spoken English. Non negotiable, our customers are American.

• You write clearly and briefly. This is the core skill of the job. Everything a customer reads will be written by you.

• You are technically literate. You do not need to write code, but you should read an error message, understand what an API or a database is, and describe a bug precisely enough that an engineer can act on it without asking you three questions.

• You are organized without needing anyone to check on you.

• At least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time.

Responsabilidades:
Product. What we build next.

• Own the weekly priority list. Ranked, with the reason behind each item. The founder approves it in 15 minutes on Monday.

• Turn scattered requests into decisions. What matters, what waits, what we never build.

• Write tickets clear enough that our engineers never ask a follow-up question.

• Keep our project board actually accurate. Today it is not.

• Test features when they ship and close the loop with whoever asked for it.

Discovery. Where the signal comes from.

• Run 3 to 5 customer calls a week. Record them, write the notes, find the pattern.

• Own Intercom. You are the first response to every customer message, every day. This is where most of the signal lives.

• Collect every request from every channel into one place.

Communication. Telling people what changed.

• Write and send release notes when we ship. Our users should never discover a feature by accident.

• Own downtime and incident communication. When something breaks, you tell people what happened and when it is fixed.

• Write and maintain our help docs.

• Update marketing copy and write blog pages as the product changes.

• Help us find users outside our current channel.

How you ramp. We are three people. You will be useful in week two, not month three.

• Week 1. You listen. Sit in every internal call, read every Intercom thread, ask a huge amount of questions. Being annoying with questions is the job.

• Week 2. You shadow the founder. You answer Intercom with him reviewing, and write your first release notes.

• Week 3 to 4. Intercom is yours. You run your first customer calls.

• Month 2. The weekly priority list is yours.

• Month 3 and on. Help docs, marketing and blog open up.

Deseable:
None of these are required. Any one of them moves you to the top of the pile.

• You know Amazon FBA, online arbitrage, or e-commerce. If you have ever sold anything on Amazon, lead with that.

• You use AI tools every day. If you have run Claude Code in a terminal, say so, that is how we work here.

• You have written marketing copy, blog posts, release notes, or help docs before, and you can show us.

• You understand UX and can give a designer feedback that is actually useful.

• You can pull your own numbers. Basic analytics, a spreadsheet, or simple SQL, so you never wait on an engineer.

• You have run user interviews and turned them into something a team could act on.

• You can ship small UI and copy fixes yourself. Not features, just the small stuff.

• You have worked at an early stage startup, employee 1 through 10. You decide without being told.

• You have used Notion, Linear, or Intercom.

Beneficios:
• 100% remote, permanently. We have never had an office.

• A small team where your work is visible immediately. No layers.

• Direct access to the founder and to real customers from day one.

• Real ownership of an area, not a piece of someone else's process.

Compensation

• USD $1,200 to $1,600 per month, based on experience.

How to apply

Send your application through Get on Board. In your cover letter, answer one question:
Tell us about a time you changed what a team was building because of something a customer told you. What did they say, and what did you do with it?

We read every one.…

postings.title: Field Validation Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Hay dos requisitos excluyentes. Si no los cumples, este no es tu rol, pero si los cumples, sigue leyendo:

• Licencia de conducir vigente y auto propio disponible durante los 4 meses. Vas a manejar rutas urbanas, de carretera y nocturnas de forma sistemática durante meses. Te reembolsamos el combustible.

• Un teléfono propio de gama alta (iPhone reciente o Android flagship). Lo integramos a la matriz de prueba como caso de uso real: con tu SIM, tu uso diario, tu patrón de carga. Solo instalamos la app de referencia del proyecto — nada más.

• Debes residir actualmente en Chile, Argentina o Perú. El cargo es 100% remoto y no requiere asistencia a oficina; sin embargo, debes tener disponibilidad para salir a realizar pruebas en terreno y ejecutar las rutas definidas para el proyecto, incluyendo rutas urbanas, de carretera, nocturnas y eventualmente durante fines de semana.

• No necesitamos que asistas a una oficina, sino que tengas disponibilidad para salir a terreno y realizar pruebas que permitan validar el funcionamiento de la SDK. Estas deberán ejecutarse según las rutas y condiciones definidas para el proyecto, incluyendo trayectos urbanos, de carretera, nocturnos y, eventualmente, durante fines de semana.

• Contrato por 4 meses, full-time, con conversación de continuidad en el mes 3.

Responsabilidades:

postings.title: Senior WordPress Maintenance & Deployment Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Must have

• 4+ years professional WordPress development including custom themes, ACF, and multilingual setups (Polylang/WPML)

• Deep hands-on Pantheon experience: dev/test/live workflow, multidev, Git mode vs SFTP mode, Autopilot, terminus CLI, and the platform's quirks (e.g., update-core hidden on test/live)

• WP Engine deployment and backup workflows

• Strong Git discipline: feature branches, clean merges, understanding why a branch 14 commits behind master is a red flag

• Front-end build pipelines: SCSS, gulp, npm — and the judgment to never commit compiled output without its source

• A documented QA habit: you can describe, step by step, what you check after a plugin update and why

• Clear written English; comfortable communicating directly with agency partners and, when needed, their clients

• Demonstrated fluency working alongside AI assistants (Claude, Copilot, or similar) in a real production workflow — and clear judgment about where AI output must be human-verified

Responsabilidades:
Run monthly plugin, theme, and WP core updates across a large Pantheon/WP Engine roster using multidev and Autopilot branches — never directly on live
Take a manual backup before every live push, without exception, and verify restore points exist before touching production
Perform structured post-deployment QA on live (key templates, archive pages, plugin-dependent modules like Ajax Load More, Polylang, ACF-driven layouts) so breakage is caught by us, not the client
Know and track plugin-specific quirks per site (e.g., plugins that need deactivate/reactivate after core updates, incompatible importers that must be disabled before a core bump) and maintain that knowledge in a living runbook
Work exclusively through source: edit SCSS/JS sources and recompile via gulp — never patch minified files directly; keep branches synced with master and named after their feature
Respect content integrity: never pull databases down over environments carrying client content; never restore backups onto a live or test environment without confirming what will be lost
Deliver monthly maintenance reports on time, in the correct format and folders, with accurate hosting/backup details per site — reports must reflect what actually shipped to live
Triage urgent "site down" flags fast, communicate root cause honestly (including when it was our push), and close tickets only when the fix is verified on live
Use AI tooling (Claude, Claude Code, and similar) as a daily co-worker: drafting QA checklists, diffing changelogs for breaking changes before updates, generating regression test lists per site, summarizing incident post-mortems, and accelerating debugging — while personally verifying everything AI produces before it ships

Deseable:
• Shopify theme development (Liquid) and app ecosystem familiarity

• ManageWP or similar fleet-management tooling

• Security hygiene: Sucuri/Wordfence triage, malware cleanup, understanding why code that silently creates admin users must never reach a client repo

• Accessibility (WCAG) scanning and remediation basics

• PHP 8.x migration experience (typed errors, deprecations)

• Experience writing client-facing maintenance reports.

• Inglés fluido

• Experiencia en dirección de fotografía o producción audiovisual.

You’ll bring structure, visibility, and momentum to complex programs, translating priorities into clear plans, coordinating teams and partners, tracking progress, and ensuring deliverables move forward on time.

The role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, proactive, comfortable managing multiple moving pieces, and confident communicating across different audiences. Strong communication skills are important, but the primary focus is program coordination, stakeholder management, and execution .

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working with cross-functional and distributed teams.

• Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communications to different audiences.

• A proactive, hands-on approach with strong ownership, judgment, and problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities while maintaining structure and momentum.

• Familiarity with modern collaboration, productivity, and project management tools, with an interest in using Gen AI to improve efficiency and ways of working.

• Experience in marketing, campaigns, customer programs, or event-related environments is a plus.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Backgrounds in program management, project management, marketing operations, campaign operations, integrated marketing, event programs, or related fields are encouraged.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Looking to do the best work of your career?

Do it with Dove , one of the most respected global brands on social. From the first idea to the final reply, you’ll shape how Dove shows up every day and create work that influences culture.

You’ll move at newsroom speed with rigorous craft—launching ideas that travel, partnering with standout creators, and turning comments into conversations that become cultural moments. The brief is straightforward: make Dove the most culturally relevant brand on social. You’ll have the scale, purpose, and creative freedom to make it real.

If you’re motivated by ideas that matter, sharpened by data, and committed to making the internet more positive, this is the place to do it. Bring your craft and your courage. Together we’ll build culture—not just content—and do the best work of our careers.

You'll be close to Dove's social channels every day, supporting the planning, publishing, and community engagement that keeps the brand's social presence consistent, culturally relevant, and growing. Based in London with a hybrid working arrangement (minimum 3 days per week on-site), you'll work alongside the Senior Social Media Manager, content creators, strategists, and the Dove brand team to ensure content lands on time, on brand, and on platform. Your understanding of how social channels work, what audiences respond to, and how to keep a content operation moving smoothly will be central to the studio's output.

You'll be one of the people who makes Dove's social presence happen, day in, day out. From content ideation, trend tracking and scheduling to community engagement, copy writing, and performance tracking, you'll manage the daily rhythm of Dove's social channels and ensure the brand shows up consistently and compellingly across platforms.

This is a role for someone who is organised, culturally-fluent, and genuinely enthusiastic about social media as a discipline. You understand what makes content work on TikTok versus Instagram versus YouTube, you can write copy that fits the tone of each platform, and you notice when something is trending before it peaks. We're looking for someone who is as comfortable managing a content calendar and pulling a performance report as they are drafting a reactive post or briefing a content creator on an emerging format.

Success means channels that run smoothly, content that consistently meets brand and platform standards, a community that feels listened to and engaged, and performance data that shows steady growth in reach, engagement, and brand affinity.

• Write and adapt social copy for each platform, ensuring Dove's tone of voice is consistent, compelling, and native to the channel

• Coordinate with the creative team and content creators to ensure assets are delivered on time, correctly formatted, and ready to publish

• Support the Senior Social Media Manager in planning always-on content, campaign activations, and seasonal or product-launch moments

Community Management and Engagement

• Monitor Dove's social channels daily, responding to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely, on-brand, and thoughtful manner

• Engage proactively with Dove's audience, fostering a sense of community and connection that reflects the brand's values of inclusivity and real beauty

• Track trending topics, hashtags, cultural moments, and platform features, flagging relevant opportunities to the wider team and, where appropriate, drafting reactive content

Performance Tracking and Reporting

postings.title: Client Account Manager II
postings.descriptionText:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

Great brands help make Pinners’ inspirations a reality, and we’re looking for a Client Account Manager II to help lead the way.

In this role, you will support one of Pinterest’s most strategic businesses in LATAM, partnering closely on the Mercado Libre business across Hispanic markets . You will help advertisers get the most out of Pinterest by driving strong campaign execution, performance optimization, measurement rigor, and clear client communication. You’ll collaborate closely with sales and cross-functional teams while helping bring structure, insights, and momentum to a complex regional account.

What you’ll do:

• Build and nurture strong relationships with partners by proactively communicating on campaign performance, optimizations, updates, and growth opportunities

• Partner closely with the Client Partner to support a complex regional business across multiple Hispanic LATAM markets

• Ensure partner objectives and requirements are met by coordinating effectively with internal teams including Measurement, Product Marketing, Creative Strategy, Performance Solutions, and others

• Gain a deep understanding of partner business goals and turn data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations

• Own the “how” conversation with advertisers by advising on targeting, bidding, creative, measurement, pacing, and optimization approaches

• Become an expert in Pinterest campaign best practices and performance solutions, and act as a trusted resource on performance-related opportunities

• Ensure campaign setup and execution are strong, monitor results closely, troubleshoot issues, and take action to course-correct when needed

• Interpret and communicate campaign results clearly so that partners understand impact, opportunity, and next steps

• Support QBRs, performance recaps, and other business reviews with strong analysis and clear recommendations

• Actively participate in client meetings, helping explain complex solutions in a simple, credible, and commercially relevant way

• Handle resistance, objections, and product questions thoughtfully and professionally

• Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities that can contribute to account growth and team revenue goals

• Maintain strong fluency in Pinterest ad products, performance solutions, and evolving roadmap updates

• Partner efficiently with cross-functional teams to resolve issues, answer technical questions, and support business growth

• Pitch new performance products and best practices at scale where relevant

What we’re looking for:

• Experience in digital advertising, account management, or media with responsibility for campaign performance and client communication

• Strong track record of turning data into compelling recommendations and business actions

• Experience managing complex workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines with strong attention to detail

• Strong understanding of campaign optimization, performance measurement, attribution, and analytical problem-solving

• Experience with technical and performance-oriented media solutions, including areas such as tagging, measurement, analytics, shopping, search, display, paid social, or lower-funnel advertising

• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in person, on the phone, and in writing

• Ability to work cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams

• Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and follow-through

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and shifting priorities

• Experience managing sophisticated client or agency relationships is strongly preferred

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as math, economics, marketing, business, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• Candidates must be based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. This role will require occasional travel to a Pinterest office for in-person collaboration 1–2 times every 6 months.

As the Sales Manager for CPG and Growth verticals in Japan, you will define, launch and drive strategic outcomes and operationalize the vision for the sales team. We’re looking for a high-performing candidate with experience building advertising / media sales teams from the ground up, passion for solving ambiguous problems, excellent communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functionally and globally. Our advertising business is thriving, our user base continues to grow, and we believe the impact of this role can fuel our company to grow in unprecedented ways.

What you’ll do:

• Drive and grow revenue with top existing and potential partners

• Partner with the world’s top marketers to build integrated marketing programs and engage partners in content growth opportunities

• Shape the future of our Sales organization by building, training and motivating a high performing advertising sales team

• Track, analyze, and communicate key quantitative metrics and business trends as they relate to partner relationships

• Build on established relationships and develop new relationships with industry CEOs, CMOs, and other key executive decision makers in the Japanese market.

• Be an internal advocate for partners by working with product and engineering teams to respond to partner needs and feedback

What we’re looking for:

• 10+ years experience in Advertising, Digital, and/or Media Sales and established industry relationships and experience working with executive level business and marketing leaders within client organizations in Japan. Business experience in advertising for CPG and direct-response advertisers would be preferable.

• 5+ years experience in sales leadership/people management

• Proven track record of managing a world-class sales team, including building & developing the team, achieving or exceeding revenue goals, long-term business development, extensive forecasting & pipeline management experience

• Strong understanding and experience in highly analytical and performance-based media organizations

• Ability to interface with product and engineering to synthesize customer needs and feedback

• Strong team player and ability to succeed in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment

• Highly regarded and well-known thought leader in the industry

postings.title: Machine Learning Intern 2027 (Zurich)
postings.descriptionText:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

As a Machine Learning Intern at Pinterest, you’ll apply machine learning and AI to product and engineering challenges. You’ll work with engineering, product and data teams to prototype, evaluate and improve ML-powered features and discovery experiences. Throughout your internship, you’ll contribute to real projects, learn how large-scale ML systems are developed and build practical skills with guidance from experienced engineers.

What you’ll do:

• Own a scoped machine learning project from problem definition through experimentation, implementation and communication of results, with guidance from your manager and team

• Contribute to applied machine learning and AI research that informs Pinterest product experiences

• Collect, analyze and synthesize data to develop data-driven machine learning models

• Write clean, efficient and maintainable code, supported by appropriate documentation and testing

• Apply relevant machine learning techniques, including natural language processing or graph-based approaches, to modeling and ranking problems across discovery, ads and search

• Break down scoped technical problems, propose approaches and implement solutions with guidance from the team

• Deliver assigned project milestones, share progress and findings with teammates and seek guidance when needed

• Experience applying machine learning or AI concepts through research, coursework, projects or internships.

• Use AI to accelerate analysis and iteration while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness and quality.

What we are looking for:

• Working towards a Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, ML, NLP, Statistics, Information Sciences or related field

• Machine Learning (ranking, computer vision, NLP, content recommendations, embedding, information retrieval etc)

• Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop/Spark) and scalable realtime systems that process stream data

• Proficiency in at least one systems language (Java, C++, Python) or one ML framework (Tensorflow, Pytorch, MLFlow)

• Experience in research and in solving analytical problems

• Strong communicator and team player with the ability to find solutions for open-ended problems

In-Office Requirement:

• This onsite internship will be based in our Zurich office requiring a few days in office. Our program will run in a full-time capacity during typical business hours between Monday-Friday.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 2-3 weekdays per week and therefore needs to be within a commutable distance of Zurich .

Relocation Statement:

• This position may be eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

• Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here .

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.

By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

We’re looking for inquisitive, collaborative interns to join our engineering teams. Working closely with mentors and product, design, data, and engineers, you’ll learn how large‑scale systems operate and play a meaningful role in building new technologies, features, and tools. Expect real projects, supportive teammates, and plenty of opportunities to explore ideas that make a difference for our teams and Pinners.

What you’ll do:

• Complete assigned technical projects with attention to quality, incorporating feedback from your mentor, manager and peers

• Execute scoped technical tasks end-to-end that contribute to Pinterest products and infrastructure

• Deliver code that is well-documented, tested, and operable

• Share ideas, questions and perspectives clearly and respectfully while learning from feedback

• Build technical and professional skills through learning and development opportunities

• Collaborate with your team and contribute to production-oriented projects that support Pinterest’s goals

• Leverage opportunities to connect with leaders and colleagues across Pinterest and participate in intern program events

• Foundational exposure to AI concepts or AI-assisted software development through coursework, projects, internships or practical experience

• Interest in learning how to use AI-powered technologies responsibly to improve product development, while validating outputs through testing, review and engineering judgment

What we’re looking for:

• This position requires current enrollment in a school or education program in which the individual is working towards a Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related technical field

• Obtain Bachelor's in Computer Science or related technical field by June 2028

• Ability to demonstrate an understanding of computer science fundamentals, including data structures and algorithms.

• Familiarity using AI as a learning, productivity, and engineering tool, and as an iterative coding partner, to accelerate engineering work while exercising strong judgment around accuracy, security, and when to ask for help

• Experience with one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, or C++, and familiarity with relevant frameworks, tools, or technologies such as React or similar. Technical requirements vary by team.

• Non-academic coding experience (i.e. hackathons, code challenges, personal projects, GitHub, Open Source, volunteer coding experience, conference participation, etc.)

• A curious nature with a desire to tackle and solve complex problem

In-Office Requirement:

• This onsite internship will be based in our Zurich office requiring a few days in office. Our program will run in a full-time capacity during typical business hours between Monday-Friday.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 2-3 weekdays per week and therefore needs to be within a commutable distance of Zurich .

Relocation Statement:

• This position may be eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

• Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here .

Great brands help make Pinner’s inspirations a reality, and we’re looking for an experienced Client Partner to help lead the way. You’ll help spread awareness and comprehension of Pinterest Business tools in Argentina, Chile and Columbia. You’ll develop strong brand relationships and work closely to help them get the most out of Pinterest's solutions and meet their business goals.

What you’ll do:

• Retain, grow and diversify the value delivered to our partners, ultimately growing Pinterest revenue as a result across Argentina, Chile and Columbia.

• Coordinate negotiations with partners to create joint business plans, learning agendas and have deep understanding of partners' business and media objectives. Responsible for stakeholder management, decision maker relationships. Arrange regular meetings with partners to discuss their requirements, learn about their objectives and remove roadblocks for partners.

• Orchestrate internal support for the client and agency to solve strategic challenges, from measurement to creative and technical integration to deliver consistent goals and objectives of the partners on a day to day.

• Produce and deliver weekly business updates outlining the current business status, key opportunities, and the accuracy of the sales pipeline.

• Specifically own the “why” Pinterest conversation with advertisers to influence the way they think about the platform’s role in their overarching media mix.

• Present tailored digital media strategies to partners that address their specific marketing needs and align with their business goals. Have a deep understanding of partners’ business goals and turn data into compelling stories through actionable insights to help them succeed. Leverage knowledge of the broader digital and advertising landscape, competitive platforms, and industry landscape to provide insights.

• Apply knowledge of customer goals and joint strategy to increase ad investment. Secure and grow revenue for Pinterest through proactive planning, pitching, deal negotiations, and upselling. Unlock new lines of revenue by navigating across multiple lines of business, marketing objectives, regions. Influences and secures budget allocation from Search, Social, Brand, Video, Agency and other relevant teams.

• Providing partners with guidance and expertise on product and service best practices and features. Be highly knowledgeable about all relevant Pinterest ad product features and capable of clearly explaining their benefits to a customer. Maintains up-to-date education and fluency on evolving product roadmap and iterations. Efficiently interfaces with appropriate cross-functional teams to answer product-related questions or challenges when needed.

What we’re looking for:

• Expertise in digital advertising and media sales including campaign optimization, analytical problem solving, and product/platform knowledge.

• Experience in marketing/advertising/digital, with specific technical acumen in Search/Shopping/Display/Social advertising technologies.

• Established industry relationships and experience working with marketing leaders within client organizations across Latin America.

• Proven track record of exceeding revenue goals.

• Ability to translate partner value across various levels, such as executive, operational, creative, media, and analytics teams.

• Strong team player and ability to succeed in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment while maintaining high levels of operational rigor, digital acumen, and business excellence.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field or equivalent experience.

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.

• Candidates must be based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. This role will require occasional travel to a Pinterest office for in-person collaboration 1–2 times every 6 months.

postings.title: University Grad Machine Learning Engineer 2027 (Zurich)
postings.descriptionText:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Pinterest, you’ll develop and improve machine learning systems that power product experiences and discovery. You’ll partner with engineering, product and design teams to build, evaluate and iterate on scalable solutions that help Pinners find relevant, inspiring content. In this role, you’ll grow your technical expertise while contributing to reliable, high-impact systems.

What you’ll do:

• Conduct applied machine learning research to address product and platform challenges at Pinterest.

• Collect, analyze and synthesize data to develop data-driven machine learning models.

• Write maintainable, efficient code and contribute to testing and code-review practices.

• Apply machine learning techniques, including natural language processing and graph-based approaches, to modeling and ranking challenges across discovery, ads and search.

• Design, build and test recommendation and engagement-prediction models that improve push, email and in-app notification experiences.

• Develop and iterate on large-scale applied machine learning systems, using evaluation results to improve model performance and reliability.

• Scope, implement and deliver solutions for moderately complex ML problems, escalating risks and tradeoffs as needed.

• Experience applying machine learning or AI concepts through research, coursework, projects or internships.

• Use AI to accelerate analysis and iteration while applying judgment and verification to ensure correctness and quality.

What we’re looking for:

• Master's in Computer Science, ML, NLP, Statistics, Information Sciences or related field required

• Machine Learning experience (ranking, computer vision, NLP, content recommendations, embedding, information retrieval etc)

• Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop/Spark) and scalable realtime systems that process stream data

• Mastery of at least one systems languages (Java, C++, Python) or one ML framework (Tensorflow, Pytorch, MLFlow)

• Cross-functional collaborator and strong communicator

• Comfortable solving ambiguous problems and adapting to a dynamic environment

• Experience in research and in solving analytical problems

This job posting is for an open vacancy. Please note that the company utilizes artificial intelligence to screen applicants for the positions.

In-Office Requirement:

• This onsite internship will be based in our Zurich office requiring a few days in office. Our program will run in a full-time capacity during typical business hours between Monday-Friday.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 2-3 weekdays per week and therefore needs to be within a commutable distance of Zurich .

Relocation Statement:

• This position may be eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

• Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here .

The minimum and maximum salary for this position is $133,600-153,600.

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.

By submitting this application, I certify that all information submitted in my application and throughout the hiring process is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that any false statement, omission, or misrepresentation may disqualify me from employment consideration or result in termination if discovered after hire.

postings.title: AI Growth Automation Engineer - Bogotá (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for someone who gets a kick out of turning "someone should really automate this" into a working tool by next week. You'll sit at the intersection of Lifecycle, Sales, and AI — building the agents, workflows, and internal products that let Clara prospect, sell, and onboard faster and smarter than a headcount-only approach ever could. This isn't a "use AI to write better emails" role. It's a build role. You'll ship things: SDR co-pilots, outbound agents, lifecycle automations, onboarding flows — and you'll own whether they actually move pipeline and activation, not just whether they're clever.

You will:

• Build AI-powered prospecting & SDR tooling: design and ship agents/workflows that find, qualify, and engage prospects, and that get meetings on AEs' calendars — using tools like Amplemarket, Clay, HubSpot, and LLM APIs, glued together with n8n or custom code.

• Own lifecycle automation end to end: build and iterate on onboarding, activation, and retention flows across email, WhatsApp, and push, using Customer.io and our internal data stack, with AI doing the heavy lifting on personalization, timing, and content generation.

• Design the SDR-to-AE handoff as a system, not a manual process: instrument lead scoring, routing, and handoff logic so reps spend time on conversations, not admin.

• Prototype fast, validate faster: you're expected to go from idea to working internal tool in days, test it against real pipeline/activation metrics, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does.

• Partner cross-functionally: work directly with Sales, SDR leadership, Lifecycle, and Data/Eng to identify where automation unlocks the most value, and to make sure what you build actually gets adopted.

• Turn data into iteration: use Metabase, HubSpot, and Customer.io data to measure what your builds are actually doing to CAC payback, meetings booked, activation rate, and pipeline generated — and report on it in plain, honest terms.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

• +2 years of hands-on experience building automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products — not just using AI tools, but shipping things that use APIs, LLMs, or agent frameworks to do real work.

• Experience with workflow/automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or equivalent) and comfort integrating APIs across systems (CRM, marketing automation, sales tooling).

• Working familiarity with CRM/lifecycle platforms such as HubSpot, Customer.io, or Salesforce.

• Enough technical fluency to read/write basic scripts (Python, JavaScript) or work closely with engineers to get something shipped — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you can't be blocked waiting for one.

• Strong written and verbal communication in English; ability to explain what you built and why it matters to non-technical stakeholders and executives.

• A bias toward building and testing over planning — you'd rather ship a rough version this week than a perfect spec next month.

Nice to haves

• Background in Lifecycle Marketing, RevOps, Sales Engineering, Product, or Software Engineering (any of these paths is fine — we care about what you've built, not your job title history).

• Direct experience with sales engagement/AI prospecting tools (Amplemarket, Clay, Apollo, or similar).

• Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and basic prompt engineering.

• Experience in B2B SaaS or fintech, ideally with an SDR/AE motion.

• Startup or small-team experience where you owned something end to end, from idea to production.

• Portuguese proficiency (not required, but useful across our MX/BR/CO/AR footprint).

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for someone who gets a kick out of turning "someone should really automate this" into a working tool by next week. You'll sit at the intersection of Lifecycle, Sales, and AI — building the agents, workflows, and internal products that let Clara prospect, sell, and onboard faster and smarter than a headcount-only approach ever could. This isn't a "use AI to write better emails" role. It's a build role. You'll ship things: SDR co-pilots, outbound agents, lifecycle automations, onboarding flows — and you'll own whether they actually move pipeline and activation, not just whether they're clever.

You will:

• Build AI-powered prospecting & SDR tooling: design and ship agents/workflows that find, qualify, and engage prospects, and that get meetings on AEs' calendars — using tools like Amplemarket, Clay, HubSpot, and LLM APIs, glued together with n8n or custom code.

• Own lifecycle automation end to end: build and iterate on onboarding, activation, and retention flows across email, WhatsApp, and push, using Customer.io and our internal data stack, with AI doing the heavy lifting on personalization, timing, and content generation.

• Design the SDR-to-AE handoff as a system, not a manual process: instrument lead scoring, routing, and handoff logic so reps spend time on conversations, not admin.

• Prototype fast, validate faster: you're expected to go from idea to working internal tool in days, test it against real pipeline/activation metrics, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does.

• Partner cross-functionally: work directly with Sales, SDR leadership, Lifecycle, and Data/Eng to identify where automation unlocks the most value, and to make sure what you build actually gets adopted.

• Turn data into iteration: use Metabase, HubSpot, and Customer.io data to measure what your builds are actually doing to CAC payback, meetings booked, activation rate, and pipeline generated — and report on it in plain, honest terms.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

• +2 years of hands-on experience building automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products — not just using AI tools, but shipping things that use APIs, LLMs, or agent frameworks to do real work.

• Experience with workflow/automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or equivalent) and comfort integrating APIs across systems (CRM, marketing automation, sales tooling).

• Working familiarity with CRM/lifecycle platforms such as HubSpot, Customer.io, or Salesforce.

• Enough technical fluency to read/write basic scripts (Python, JavaScript) or work closely with engineers to get something shipped — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you can't be blocked waiting for one.

• Strong written and verbal communication in English; ability to explain what you built and why it matters to non-technical stakeholders and executives.

• A bias toward building and testing over planning — you'd rather ship a rough version this week than a perfect spec next month.

Nice to haves

• Background in Lifecycle Marketing, RevOps, Sales Engineering, Product, or Software Engineering (any of these paths is fine — we care about what you've built, not your job title history).

• Direct experience with sales engagement/AI prospecting tools (Amplemarket, Clay, Apollo, or similar).

• Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and basic prompt engineering.

• Experience in B2B SaaS or fintech, ideally with an SDR/AE motion.

• Startup or small-team experience where you owned something end to end, from idea to production.

• Portuguese proficiency (not required, but useful across our MX/BR/CO/AR footprint).

Where we work

This is a hybrid role: you'll split your time between the office, customers and home. We don't set a minimum number of office days for most roles — you'll spend time in the office naturally, and most days during your ramp-up or when your leader asks.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Design Engineer, Web (AI-Native) - Hybrid
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do
You will design and build our website. This is a hands-on role for a website designer who builds with AI: you take a page from concept to production, using AI tools and code as part of your daily workflow, and you ship pages that convert across LatAm.

Success means building a website operation that continuously ships and continuously improves. You’ll integrate the existing site into an AI-native CI/CD workflow that makes it faster and safer to launch, test, learn, and iterate. Your work will be measured by the quality and consistency of the experience, conversion impact, speed to ship, and how effectively the systems you build make future work faster.

Your responsibilities

• Design and build Clara's website on our own stack: page templates, components, and a design system that lets the team launch pages in hours, not weeks.

• Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, v0, Lovable, Figma AI, or similar) to go from brief to live page, and know when to take over and finish by hand.

• Build and operate agentic workflows for website delivery. Break larger website initiatives into parallel workstreams and use specialized AI agents for tasks such as implementation, QA, accessibility, performance, content validation, analytics, and localization.

• Prototype interactions at high fidelity. Use Figma, code, AI tools, and browser prototypes to demonstrate how the experience should actually behave before it reaches production.

• Use AI to accelerate concept exploration. Generate multiple layout, interaction, and component directions quickly, then curate, refine, and bring the strongest concepts to production quality. Create repeatable processes where AI can help generate

• Scout, pilot, and adopt new AI design and development tools. Explore AI-assisted component generation, design-system workflows, prototyping, and documentation so the whole team can ship faster without lowering quality.

• Maintain quality across the entire product-marketing surface. Ensure that web experiences, product demos, landing pages, interactive tools, and campaign experiences feel like parts of the same system.

postings.title: GTM/ Sales - Country Lead - Argentina (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Country Lead Argentina to spearhead our commercial operations and rapidly scale Clara's presence in the region. In this highly strategic role, you will own and deploy the go-to-market strategy for the Clara Global product across the region, while also orchestrating the rollout of our broader product suite. You will bridge local execution with strategic alignment from our Mexico headquarters, defining what winning looks like for Clara in a net-new territory.

•
Design and execute the regional go-to-market strategy for Clara Global and other core products, ensuring tight collaboration and alignment with our central operations in Mexico.

•
Prioritize and relentlessly execute the generation of new business for the Clara Global product, identifying and closing net-new companies globally that require a modern, multi-currency reimbursements solution.

•
Operate as a strategic advisor to our installed base as your second key priority, working directly with active clients to drive adoption of our new reimbursements solution and increase Total Payment Volume (TPV).

•
Lead consultative, high-impact product demos with CFOs, Finance Directors, and HR leaders, positioning Clara as the definitive alternative to fragmented global expense processes.

•
Generate a high-quality pipeline through targeted outbound strategies using Amplemarket , LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and creative multi-channel approaches.

•
Maintain pristine pipeline hygiene and accurate forecasting in HubSpot , applying structured qualification frameworks across a high-volume funnel.

•
Act as the internal vanguard for market expansion—relaying cross-border regulatory context, pricing feedback, and market intelligence to Product and Leadership via Slack .

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves:

•
Minimum 8 years of enterprise sales or business development experience at a technology or fintech company, with a consistent track record of top performance on strategic accounts.

•
Demonstrated experience selling payments, financial infrastructure, or fintech products to large enterprise customers.

•
Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and lead commercial negotiations, including bespoke deal structures.

•
Exceptional cross-functional leadership and ability to influence across all levels, with high comfort toggling between big-picture strategy and detailed execution.

•
Proven role-specific execution in building territories and pipelines from the ground up, with high adaptability to fast-changing environments.

•
Experience or interest in AI tools (such as N8N ) to automate workflows, accelerate prospecting, and evolve sales operations.

•
Hands-on proficiency with CRM tools like HubSpot and outbound prospecting platforms like Amplemarket .

•
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Nice to haves:

•
Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it.

•
Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or BI tools like Metabase to evaluate pipeline coverage and territory data.

•
A good sense of humor.

How we work in this territory

Argentina is an emerging territory for Clara — there's no office to go into, so this role works remotely from Argentina day to day. You'll ramp up in person with the team, and come together in person for team moments, events and customer visits through the year.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

postings.title: Paid Media Specialist - Argentina (Hybrid)
postings.descriptionText:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

This is a highly hands-on Paid Media role. You will work directly inside the advertising platforms every day—building and launching campaigns, uploading creatives and copy, checking tracking, monitoring performance, and making optimizations.
This is not a strategy-only, coordination, or people-management position. We’re looking for someone who enjoys executing the work themselves and taking direct ownership of campaigns from setup through ongoing optimization.
You’ll manage campaigns across multiple platforms and markets while using AI as a core part of your workflow. You’ll be operating within one of Latin America’s fastest-growing companies, as ranked by the Financial Times, on a team that is actively building AI-native workflows into everything we do.
Your work will directly impact how Clara grows across Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia—and you’ll help define what AI-augmented Paid Media execution looks like at scale

Your responsibilities will include:

• Launch, monitor and quality assurance of campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other platforms.

• Set up tracking and attribution according to internal guidelines — including AI-assisted tagging validation and anomaly detection.

• Use AI tools daily to accelerate campaign work: generating ad copy variants, summarizing performance data, building audience hypotheses, and drafting creative briefs.

• Conduct keyword and audience research using both native platform tools and AI-powered research assistants (e.g. Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, custom GPTs).

• Support in A/B tests and make regular optimizations — using AI to generate hypotheses, interpret results, and suggest next steps.

• Build and maintain recurring performance reports, leveraging AI to surface insights and write narrative summaries.

• Use automation tools (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier) to reduce repetitive manual work and create scalable workflows around campaign management.

• Work closely with the Growth Team and support teams — using AI to speed up collaboration, from briefing creative to aligning on copy.

Who you are:

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves:

• 2+ year of experience managing campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads (other platforms are a plus, but not required).

• Knows how to navigate ad platforms, create audiences, choose formats, and optimize campaigns.

• Confident working with data and tracking the main Paid Media KPIs (spreadsheets, Looker Studio, Power BI, platform native reporting tools or similar).

• Active, daily user of AI tools — you use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or similar tools as part of your real workflow, not just occasionally.

• Can write effective prompts: you know how to give AI models context, constraints and examples to get useful outputs on the first or second try.

• Has experience using AI to produce or improve ad copy, creative briefs, keyword lists, or performance summaries.

• Organized, precise and able to handle multiple campaigns in parallel.

• Comfortable communicating with both technical and non-technical teams.

• Genuinely interested in Paid Media and willing to go deep.

Nice to haves:

• Experience with automation tools like n8n, Make or Zapier to build workflows around paid media tasks.

• Experience building custom GPTs, AI agents, or AI-assisted reporting pipelines.

• Experience with less common platforms (Spotify Ads, programmatic, Uber Ads etc.).

• Interest or experience in AI workflows, internal tooling, or prompt engineering.

• Experience collaborating with creative teams — including using AI to brief or iterate on creative assets.

• Experience working with B2B SaaS or Fintech.

• Experience with MMMs and/or advanced attribution models.

• Basic understanding of landing page CRO, Google Analytics, or CRM tools like HubSpot.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

• An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

• English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

• Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

• Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

• Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

• Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Product Lead, Collections to own the strategy, execution, and business outcomes for our Collections squad at Clara. In this role, you will lead a squad sitting at the intersection of credit risk, finance operations, and customer experience—ensuring we recover what's owed efficiently, compliantly, and without compromising customer trust. You will partner with senior software engineers alongside Risk, Finance, Legal, and Customer Support to drive the end-to-end collection lifecycle, lending facilities management, and delinquent portfolio tools.

•
Own discovery, prioritization, and business outcomes for the squad, driving impact across recovery rates, days-to-resolution, roll rates, and operational costs.

•
Talk to internal finance and collections teams weekly to identify friction points, automate manual tasks, and optimize internal operational tooling.

•
Design and iterate on collections workflows, ranging from automated early-stage nudges and digital payment use cases to late-stage escalation paths and external partner handoffs.

•
Manage delinquent portfolio tools, early delinquency signals, and regulatory compliance requirements across our core Latin American markets (Mexico, Colombia, and Brazil).

•
Prototype and validate product ideas using AI tools before committing engineering bandwidth, occasionally contributing code changes (copy, configuration, feature flags, or analytics instrumentation) through standard GitHub PRs.

•
Collaborate closely with engineering to support max uptime, system reliability, and rapid recovery processes.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

•
Working proficiency in English.

•
5+ years in product management, with at least 2 years owning a credit, collections, or risk-adjacent product within a fintech, bank, or lending company.

•
Proven track record of directly moving core business metrics and taking full ownership of product outcomes from discovery to execution.

•
Hands-on technical fluency with web architecture concepts (APIs, services, databases, message queuing) and comfortable using Github workflows (branches, commits, PRs, diffs).

•
Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows, validate ideas early, and optimize day-to-day work.

•
Strong data literacy with hands-on experience writing SQL , conducting cohort analysis, and running experiment design.

•
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
Adaptability to fast-changing environments, operating with high agency and a bias toward action.

Nice to haves

•
Basic proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese or a desire to learn it.

•
Cross-border experience across Latin American markets (MX, CO, BR), including knowledge of market-specific payment gateways, external collections agency integrations, or local debt recovery regulations.

•
Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL , or Python to build custom dashboards and run deep-dive data pulls.

•
A good sense of humor.

Auth Engineer — Users & Auth

We're looking for an Auth Engineer to own, architect, and build the systems that define how users exist and move within Clara's platform — authentication, authorization, identity, and access control. This is one of those roles where the work is invisible when it's done right and critical when it's not. The scope is deep and end-to-end: architecting the identity layer, designing auth flows, managing the user lifecycle, integrating Auth0 with Clara's platform, and making sure the frontend and backend sides of identity speak the same language. You'll be the person the rest of engineering turns to when there's an auth question no one else can answer. Security isn't a checklist here — it's a first-class concern baked into how we build.

We move fast and trust our engineers to own outcomes end-to-end. That means autonomy to make decisions, proactivity to surface problems before they become blockers, and the attitude to push initiatives across the finish line without waiting to be told what to do.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing and building the identity and access layer that Clara's apps rely on across products — making it work end-to-end and hold up as the platform grows, in close partnership with the team's tech lead

• Owning auth end-to-end: architecture, implementation, and Auth0 integration across frontend and backend

• Designing and hardening auth flows and the full user lifecycle

• Being a strong reference on identity and access for the rest of engineering — a go-to for the hard auth problems that block other teams

• Setting and holding the security and quality bar on identity-critical paths through code reviews and design reviews

• Partnering with the team's tech lead and with product on the feasibility of auth-heavy initiatives, and spotting where AI tooling can close work that would otherwise take months

Who you are

• 4+ years of software engineering experience with solid execution in production environments

• 2+ years of hands-on experience implementing authentication and authorization on a modern identity platform — experience with Auth0 specifically is preferred, comparable platforms is also welcome; IAM depth is a strong plus

• Full-stack engineering with your strength on the backend. We work primarily in Java and Spring on the backend and React on the frontend — depth in those is a plus, but we care more about strong fundamentals and how fast you ramp than about years in any one stack

• Deep understanding of security best practices for web applications and secure software design in distributed architectures

• High autonomy, proactivity, and ownership mindset. You don't wait for direction — you spot what needs to happen and drive it

• A genuine pull toward AI. You don't need to be an expert, but you're actively experimenting with AI tools in your day-to-day work, keep up with where the space is going, and are eager to apply it to how we build. At Clara, AI is part of how we work, not a side topic

• English proficiency, comfortable communicating and collaborating on technical topics across geographies

We've kept this list short on purpose — these are the things that actually matter. If you check most of these and the rest you'd close with curiosity and the right tools, we want to hear from you.

Where we work

This is a remote-first role: you'll work from home day to day. You'll ramp up in person with the team, and come together in person for team moments, events and customer visits through the year.

Why Clara

• A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

• ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

• Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.
