• Ser nativo/a de Argentina o tener un gran conocimiento de las cuentas Enterprise en Argentina es un plus.

A QUIÉN BUSCAMOS

Este puesto requiere la asistencia a la oficina al menos 1 vez por semana.

You will be responsible for building and scaling a reseller and alliance ecosystem across two high-potential markets, combining hunting for new channel partners with the development and management of existing ones. You will operate with high autonomy, executing go-to-market strategies through brokers, HR consultancies, benefits companies, banks, and fintechs to drive B2B revenue through indirect channels. This role requires a commercially sharp, resourceful professional who understands the indirect channel business, can open doors with senior stakeholders, and knows how to create value both for partners and for Wellhub.

YOUR IMPACT

• Build and grow the channel partner ecosystem across Argentina and Chile, identifying, onboarding, and developing strategic alliances with benefits brokers, HR consultancies, voucher/benefits companies, banks, and fintechs.

• Drive indirect revenue through a mix of hunting new reseller partners and farming existing alliances, ensuring consistent pipeline generation and deal conversion through the channel.

• Own end-to-end partner relationships — from commercial negotiation and contract structuring to joint go-to-market execution, co-marketing initiatives, and ongoing performance management.

• Design and execute joint go-to-market strategies with partners, coordinating internally with Marketing, Sales Team, and Operations to ensure aligned initiatives that maximize channel revenue.

• Prospect and engage senior decision-makers (commercial directors, HR leaders, C-suite) at potential partner organizations, building a qualified pipeline of new alliance opportunities.

• Monitor and report channel performance with accuracy, maintaining forecast discipline and proactively managing risks in the indirect pipeline.

• Ensure commercial sustainability by managing partner margins, MAP clauses, and deal structures that protect Wellhub’s margin while remaining competitive in the market.

• Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves.

WHO YOU ARE

• An experienced channel and alliances professional with 5–7 years of experience in indirect sales, reseller partnerships, or B2B alliance management, ideally in multi-stakeholder commercial environments.

• A hunter-farmer hybrid — you’re equally comfortable opening new partner relationships from scratch and deepening existing ones to unlock long-term revenue.

• A commercially-driven operator with solid understanding of partner economics, margin management, deal structuring, and reseller go-to-market models.

• An autonomous and resourceful professional capable of navigating ambiguity, managing complex negotiations, and driving results without a direct team to lean on.

• A skilled communicator and influencer with the ability to engage and persuade senior stakeholders both externally (partners) and internally (cross-functional teams).

• Familiar with the Argentina and Chilean business landscape, including local dynamics in HR, benefits, and corporate services markets.

• Experienced in or exposed to SaaS, wellness, or HR technology environments — a strong plus but not a hard requirement.

• Fluent in Spanish and English (advanced/fluent), with professional proficiency required to operate in our global environment.

• Strategic & Analytical: You are both strategic and analytical, able to optimize the sales funnel, analyze workflows, and use data to inform expansion decisions.

• The Multilingual Requirement: You communicate confidently with native or professional fluency in German (with deep understanding of Austrian and Swiss corporate nuances) and full professional fluency in English . Fluency in French is a strong advantage (critical for the Swiss Romandie region).

• Hands-on & Pragmatic: You are a hands-on leader with a positive, solution-oriented approach, motivated by the challenge of building a commercial engine from scratch.

postings.title: Account Executive, Marketplace Sales
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

We're looking for a driven Sales Account Executive to manage inbound leads and grow an existing book of business—helping customers find the right manufacturing solution for their projects while building long-term, trusted relationships.

This is a great opportunity for a sales professional who wants full-cycle ownership, direct customer impact, and room to grow within a fast-scaling company.

How You'll Contribute:

Sales & Account Management

• Convert inbound leads into long-term customers and manage a growing book of business

• Build relationships rooted in trust, service, and honesty; identify strategic accounts with repeat-order potential

• Own and execute account plans to hit sales quotas, drive profitable growth, and expand market share

• Negotiate pricing and terms to close deals that work for both the customer and the business

Technical Consultation

• Serve as the primary point of contact for new prototyping and low-volume production projects

• Guide customers in selecting the right manufacturing technology (e.g., 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding) for their development needs

• Deliver technical presentations at customer seminars and industry events

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with sales engineering to translate customer requirements into accurate, timely quotes

• Document and hand off new customer requirements clearly so project management and internal teams can execute without delay

• Track and report on industry trends, competitive intelligence, and customer activity to inform sales strategy

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience

• Advanced English proficiency (required — role supports English-speaking customers)

• 2+ years in a full-cycle, quota-carrying sales role

• Experience in high-volume inbound sales

• CRM experience (Salesforce or similar) required

• Comfort with Google Suite, Microsoft Office, and video conferencing tools (Zoom, WebEx, GoToMeeting)

• Strong negotiation skills and a results-driven mindset

• High energy, positive attitude, and comfort engaging with customers daily

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

• Familiarity with additive manufacturing or traditional manufacturing processes a plus

• Ability to work on-site 1x a week

Please submit your resume in English.

#Promoted

postings.title: Associate Account Manager, Digital Marketing
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

At Thomas, we're revolutionizing the manufacturing industry with our cutting-edge omnichannel growth marketing strategies. With a remarkable 125-year legacy in the business, we're now expanding our customer-focused Client Services team to serve our most upper-tier customers.

As an Associate Account Manager, you will collaborate with your clients to gain a deep understanding of their unique business objectives and design digital strategies to drive tangible outcomes.

What you'll be doing as an Associate Account Manager:

• Serve as the primary strategic lead for a portfolio of industrial clients to cultivate strong and trusted partnerships with each of them

• Plan, collect, and document client goals and deliverable feedback for use by cross-functional teams (coordinators, design, development, and SEM)

• Partner with cross-functional teams to execute marketing campaigns, ensure alignment with client expectations, and deliver on ROI

• Lead biweekly or monthly (dependent on program scope) client calls to review program KPIs, deliverable updates, and program progress

• Consult with and educate clients on the digital marketing best practices that guide the strategic direction for their program

Address clients’ questions or concerns about the performance of their program and provide strategic and tactical solutions

• Leverage data analytics to uncover actionable insights, identify trends, and make informed recommendations to optimize marketing campaigns continually

• Collaborate with Sales to offer a holistic service that can lead to increased revenue

• Develop, present, and implement holistic growth marketing strategies that align with the clients’ goals, covering aspects like user acquisition, conversion, and revenue growth

What you bring to our team:

• 1-3 years experience in a digital marketing role; agency preferred

• Minimum 1 year of client-facing experience

• Minimum 1 year of project management experience

• Knowledge of best practices for SEO/AEO, PPC, and email marketing

• Experience with our tech stack: Google Analytics, Data Studio Reports, WordPress and/or HubSpot

• Outstanding communication and people skills

Nice-to-have experience:

•

• B2B and/or industrial/manufacturing industry knowledge

• Experience using SEO tools (e.g., SEMRush, AHRefs, Google Ads, Optmyzer, Google Search Console), LinkedIn analytics, Data Studio reporting from Google, A/B testing software, and/or chatbot plugins

• Experience using marketing platform tools (e.g., HubSpot, Pardot, etc.)

• Certifications: Google Analytics, Google Ads, and/or project management

Please submit your Resume in English.

postings.descriptionText:

Xometry is seeking a Performance Marketing Copywriter to own the copy that carries a prospect from click to conversion — marketing and lifecycle emails, video/explainer scripts, and the landing pages that sit at the end of the funnel, across both the Xometry and Thomas brands. Reporting to the Content Director, you'll work closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Growth Marketing, Product, designers, and video producers to turn campaign strategy into copy that guides engineers, procurement professionals, and manufacturing leaders toward a decision.

How You’ll Contribute:

• Write marketing and lifecycle emails — welcome series, nurture/engagement workflows, and promotional campaigns — for both the Xometry and Thomas brands

• Write video scripts for YouTube, paid social, and product explainer videos, translating technical capabilities into clear, credible narratives

• Write landing page copy that converts, from hero messaging and value props through to CTAs, aligned with the traffic source and offer

• Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to plan and sequence email journeys, and with designers/video producers to align copy with visuals and pacing

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Content, and Growth Marketing to keep messaging aligned with campaign goals and brand voice

• Use performance data (open rate, CTR, CVR, watch-through rate) and testing insights to refine copy for higher engagement and conversion

• Contribute to campaign brainstorms and messaging strategy with a creative, test-and-learn mindset

• Maintain and evolve messaging frameworks, email templates, and landing page copy blocks for reuse across campaigns

• Build and use Claude Skills to speed up copy production, QA, and A/B test variant generation

• Maintain a deep understanding of target audiences across both the Xometry and Thomas platforms

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• 4+ years of experience writing for performance marketing, lifecycle/email marketing, or growth-focused content roles

• Proven track record of writing high-converting email, video script, and/or landing page copy

• Strong understanding of email marketing mechanics — segmentation, sequencing, deliverability basics — and of landing page structure and conversion principles

• Familiarity with performance KPIs (open rate, CTR, CVR, ROAS) and how copy drives them

• Comfort and proficiency with HubSpot or a similar CRM/ESP platform, A/B testing, and AI tools

• Demonstrated project management and organizational skills for managing multiple campaigns and drafts at once

• Excellent English grammar, editing, and messaging skills in a B2B context

• Adept at building Claude Skills (or comparable custom AI workflows/agents) to scale copy production — not just prompting, but structuring reusable skills

Preferred

• Experience in manufacturing, engineering, or industrial sectors

• Familiarity with Xometry's buyer personas or similar ICP-driven marketing

• Experience briefing or storyboarding video scripts alongside a production or design team

• Track record shipping multiple Claude Skills or AI workflows into an active production/creative pipeline

Key Competencies

• Strong copywriting craft across long-form and short-form formats

• Ability to simplify complex engineering concepts into a clear customer narrative

• Data-driven mindset balanced with creative instinct

• Fast iteration and testing mentality

• Collaborative, cross-disciplinary approach

• Ownership from creative brief to published send/page/video

• Fluent building with Claude Skills — designs and ships reusable skills, not just prompts

Scope & Decision-Making

• Owns copy execution for assigned email flows, video scripts, and landing pages across the Xometry and Thomas brands

• Makes day-to-day copy and messaging decisions within brand guidelines

• Collaborates on campaign and lifecycle strategy with Growth Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, and Creative leadership

• Escalates risks related to brand voice, compliance, or performance

postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is looking for a Customer Marketing Manager responsible for champion-led growth (CLG) and engagement of our existing buyer accounts. You will build the mechanisms that turn buyers into advocates at scale — referrals, reviews, incentives, and buyer stories — and design the strategies that grow adoption within the installed base. This is a role for someone who wants full ownership of the existing-customer lifecycle — driving deeper engagement, expansion, and loyalty — and who can turn that advocacy into stories the rest of the business can use.

How You’ll Contribute:

Champion-Led Growth Strategy

• Own and execute the CLG strategy across the existing buyer base, driving advocacy, referrals, and account expansion at scale

• Build advocacy mechanisms — referral programs, review/reference programs, incentive structures, and integration/plug-in opportunities — that convert satisfied buyers into active champions

• Identify and prioritize which accounts and buyer segments are best positioned for expansion, referral, or advocacy motions

Customer Engagement & Retention

• Design the account engagement journey for existing accounts, including triggers, segmentation, and offers that drive re-engagement and deepen adoption

• Partner with various Marketing teams to translate strategy into executed campaigns — this role owns the playbook and the outcomes

• Continuously test and refine triggers and segments based on account behavior and performance data

Advocacy & Customer Storytelling

• Turn the advocacy engine into a pipeline of buyer stories — case studies, testimonials, and proof points that Sales, Marketing, and cross functional teams can use

• Partner with Commercial Marketing & Enablement to ensure buyer stories feed directly into sales enablement assets

• Build repeatable processes for sourcing, capturing, and publishing buyer stories at scale

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• 5+ years of B2B lifecycle, customer/account based marketing, or growth marketing experience, ideally within a marketplace or platform business

• Demonstrated experience designing and running lifecycle programs (triggers, segmentation, nurture) that measurably grow existing accounts

• Track record of building advocacy or referral programs from the ground up

• Comfort working cross-functionally with channel owners (e.g., email/MarTech) where you own strategy and outcomes but not day-to-day execution

• Strong analytical skills — comfortable defining segments, reading account-level data, and tying lifecycle activity back to bookings growth

• Fluency with AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, or similar) as a core part of your daily workflow — for research, content, analysis, and experimentation. This is a baseline expectation for the entire marketing team

• Clear, direct communicator who can turn buyer advocacy into compelling stories for internal and external audiences

Preferred

• Experience in a two-sided marketplace model

• Familiarity with customer marketing or advocacy platforms (e.g., referral/review tooling, customer marketing platforms)

• Comfort operating in a high-growth environment where programs are built before all the processes exist

postings.title: Sales Operations Data Analyst
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a Sales Operations Data Analyst who will play a pivotal role in shaping our sales strategy by providing reporting and valuable insights on sales data and activities. You will directly support sales leadership while driving the development and implementation of our sales analytics and data strategy, while identifying trends and recommend solutions or processes to drive sales effectiveness.

How You'll Contribute:

• Creation, analysis, and distribution of reports and dashboards for Sales

• Create ad-hoc reports and analysis as needed

• Problem-solving and troubleshooting data reporting inaccuracies

• Assist in creating, maintaining, and optimizing analytic models

• Follow and develop reporting best practices

• Transform data into actionable insights and visualize it effectively using tools like Looker

• Demonstrate a passion for working with data and the ability to turn raw data into actionable insights

• Serve as a liaison between our data needs and what is currently available, guiding data cleansing efforts when necessary

• Possess the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders with data-driven insights

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a relevant discipline. Master's degree preferred

• 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst or Business Analyst, preferably with a focus on sales analytics

• Advanced in SQL and Looker (not Looker Studio), and preferably LookML

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.

• Ability to communicate complex findings and insights to non-technical stakeholders

• Ability to independently source and assess data for relevance

• Familiarity with data cleansing processes and experience in data cleaning is a plus

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders.

• Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change

• Nice to have experience using: Snowflake, Salesforce, dbt (data build tool), GitHub, Excel

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Please submit your resume in English

#LI-Hybrid

#Promoted

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science team. This person will drive data science initiatives, provide technical guidance when needed, and leverage data to solve complex business challenges. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of data science methodologies, strong statistical expertise, and proven experience delivering impactful data solutions in a dynamic environment. This is a 1-year contract with the potential for extension.

Responsibilities:

• Use data analysis, visualization, and modeling tools (e.g., Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Python, Pandas) to drive data-driven business strategies, with a focus on cost prediction for a two-sided marketplace.

• Design and execute data science projects, including hypothesis development, statistical analysis, and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing) to answer key business questions and validate assumptions.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into data science solutions and ensure alignment with Xometry’s objectives.

• Analyze existing algorithms for accuracy and performance, provide recommendations for optimization, and update production code as necessary.

• Query and extract data from databases (e.g., Snowflake, MongoDB) to support analysis and model development.

• Implement robust data science methodologies, emphasizing best practices in code reproducibility, version control, and model deployment.

• Continuously iterate and improve solutions within a fast-paced, agile environment, addressing challenges with innovative, data-driven approaches.

• Foster a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and continuous learning, encouraging knowledge sharing and skill development within the team.

Qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree is required; an advanced degree (M.S. or PhD) in applied math, computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field is highly preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in data science

• Strong expertise in SQL and Python (numpy, scipy, pandas, and scikit-learn preferred) and experience with API integrations using Python.

• Proficient in applied statistics, including knowledge of probability distributions, confidence intervals, statistical tests (e.g., t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-Square), and power analysis.

• Experience with pricing algorithms and technology-driven product development.

• Knowledge of scientific software principles, including version control, code reproducibility, and deployment practices.

• Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and manage shifting priorities effectively.

• Must be able to work core hours aligned with US Eastern Time (GMT-5).

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with global teams and articulate complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

postings.title: Social & Community Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is looking for a Social & Community Manager to own how the brand shows up, sounds, and responds across organic social and community spaces every single day. You will be the face of Xometry online — the daily voice, the person engaging in the communities where our buyers and suppliers already are, and the one making sure nothing falls through the cracks when someone reaches out. This role is part storyteller, part community builder, part first responder. You keep the content calendar on track and partner with our agency on production, but the voice, the engagement, and the day-to-day judgment calls are yours. You'll stand up the tools and triage process that let us listen and respond in real time, and you'll pull in subject matter experts when a conversation needs real technical credibility behind it.

How You’ll Contribute:

• Serve as the face of Xometry and operational lead for organic social & community — owning daily voice, community engagement, and servicing triage

• Represent Xometry in buyer and supplier communities (forums, Reddit, YouTube)

• Stand up a social listening/servicing tool

• Own the social content calendar and partner with the agency on content creation

• Establish a servicing triage process for community and social inquiries

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

• 7+ years experience managing organic social and/or online community programs, ideally in a B2B or technical industry

• Strong writing skills and a distinct, adaptable voice — comfortable engaging authentically in forums, Reddit, and other community spaces

• Experience with or working knowledge of social listening/servicing tools

• Ability to triage and prioritize inbound engagement, knowing when to respond directly and when to loop in subject matter experts

• Comfort partnering with an agency on content production while retaining ownership of voice and strategy

• A proactive, community-first mindset — you notice what's happening in the conversation and show up in it

#LI-Remote
Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

postings.title: Website Project Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

We are seeking a highly organized and client-savvy Website Project Manager to serve as the engine behind our website build delivery for mid-market manufacturing clients. This is a unique opportunity for a solution-oriented project management practitioner to bridge the gap between technical B2B buyers and the internal teams who bring their websites to life.

You will thrive at the intersection of client relationship management and operational delivery, specializing in translating ambiguous, non-marketing language from manufacturing clients into clear, actionable direction for designers, developers, and content editors. As both the client's primary point of contact and the internal team's source of truth, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of standard and mid-complexity website build projects, from kickoff through launch, ensuring they are delivered on schedule, within scope, and within budget — without requiring daily oversight from leadership.

How You'll Contribute:

• Project Delivery & Leadership:

• Own project delivery end-to-end, leading post-sale website build projects from kickoff to launch with minimal daily oversight

• Manage resourcing to keep project velocity on pace with milestones by coordinating with department heads to secure design and development resources

• Coordinate quality assurance and risk mitigation by working with QA to confirm deliverables meet internal and client standards, and identify and resolve risks before they affect the timeline

• Client Relationship Management:

• Serve as the primary client contact for assigned manufacturing clients: run client meetings, deliver weekly status updates, and turn client input into clear direction for internal teams

• Decode client intent for the internal team by employing analytical skills and curiosity to determine their true business needs, especially when their feedback does not align cleanly with standard marketing terms (e.g., inquiring about their standard customer profile rather than asking for a “target persona”)

• Guide projects toward sound solutions by gathering usable feedback on deliverables, offering real-time resolutions, and clearly relaying client feedback to production team members for implementation

• Scope, Budget & Documentation:

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

The Mission

We are looking for a sharp, analytical, and highly proactive Operations Analyst to join our Service Delivery Operations team. This role operates at the intersection of workforce planning, staffing, capacity management, delivery operations, and operational intelligence.

The Operations Analyst will help translate business demand into workforce and operational decisions by analyzing capacity, skills, utilization, pipeline, delivery needs, and operational risk. You will partner across Delivery, Sales, Talent, Finance, and other business functions to identify constraints, surface risks, recommend actions, and drive decisions through execution.

This role will increasingly focus on exception management, analytical judgment, workforce optimization, and decision support rather than transactional coordination and manual reporting.

The ideal candidate is a strong critical thinker who can operate independently in ambiguity, connect information across multiple parts of the business, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and turn data into clear recommendations and action.

Your Assignment

• Manage day-to-day operational activities for an assigned area of the business, developing a strong understanding of its demand, workforce, capacity, staffing needs, delivery risks, and business priorities.

• Analyze demand, capacity, skills, utilization, availability, pipeline, bench, and delivery requirements to identify risks, constraints, opportunities, and recommended actions.

• Manage staffing and resource-allocation workflows from demand identification through assignment, applying established governance while balancing customer needs, skills alignment, utilization, and enterprise capacity.

• Partner with Delivery, Sales, Talent, Finance, and other stakeholders to translate business demand into workforce plans and provide data-driven staffing, capacity, and hiring recommendations.

• Identify and proactively escalate capacity constraints, staffing conflicts, bench risk, skills gaps, forecast variance, and other operational exceptions with recommended actions—not simply status updates.

• Develop and maintain workforce and operational intelligence that enables leadership to understand trends, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions required across the business.

• Use AI, automation, analytics, and operational systems to reduce manual work, improve data quality, identify patterns, and increase the speed and quality of operational decision-making.

• Identify, design, and implement process and workflow improvements that increase scalability, accountability, and operational effectiveness.

• Maintain strong operational governance and data integrity across staffing, capacity, forecasting, project lifecycle, and delivery systems.

• Support end-to-end delivery operations, including Sales-to-Delivery transitions, resource planning, staffing assignments, project setup and closeout, and engagement data integrity.

• Own recurring capacity, staffing, and forecasting reviews for assigned business areas, ensuring leadership receives decision-ready insights rather than transactional reporting.

• Work independently within established operating frameworks, proactively resolving issues and escalating exceptions that require broader business tradeoffs or leadership decisions.

Your Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 3–5 years of experience in an operations, resource management, workforce planning, staffing, or capacity planning role within a consulting or professional services environment.

• Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze business problems, identify root causes, evaluate tradeoffs, and recommend appropriate actions.

• Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting utilization, capacity, availability, demand, pipeline, forecasting, and other operational metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, operate effectively in ambiguity, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and proactively drive work through resolution.

• Strong business judgment and communication skills, with the ability to connect information across functions and translate data and findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.

• Experience with professional services and resource management systems such as Certinia PSA and Salesforce, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with AWS, cloud consulting, or technology professional services environments.

• Familiarity with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI.

• Exposure to GenAI and automation tools used to improve operational workflows, analysis, or decision-making.

• Advanced proficiency with Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel.

We are seeking a highly experienced and skilled Principal Data Architect to join our Cloud Data Engineering Practice. The Principal Data Architect will be responsible for leading the design and implementation of complex cloud-based data solutions for our customers. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of cloud data and analytics technologies.

Your Assignment

• Define strategic roadmaps and targeted outcomes for our clients in a consultative capacity

■ Relational database design, optimization and migration

■ Data modeling for both transactional and analytics systems including implementation of industry standard data models

■ BI dashboards and visualizations

■ Data Governance and MDM

○ New Data (at least 2):

■ Big data processing using Spark, Streaming solutions, and NoSQL

■ Machine Learning and MLOps with proficiency in Sagemaker

■ GenAI Foundational Models as well as approaches and frameworks used in conjunction with them with proficiency in Bedrock.

■ DataOps practices (Infrastructure as Code, Data Testing, Data Versioning, etc)

• Experience with at least two of these:

○ Infrastructure as Code tools

○ CI/CD pipelines and tools

○ Python for analytics (numpy, pandas, matplotlib etc) and automation

• Strong drive towards standardizing and documenting our approach and solutions ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills

The Mission

We are seeking a talented Security Engineer to join our growing Security team. The right candidate is someone who has a mix of AWS skills, networking familiarity, curiosity in emerging AI technologies, and a knack for tying it all together securely. ... Your mission will be helping improve Caylent’s security and compliance posture across AWS and various SaaS environments, improving our vulnerability management processes, and keeping Caylent safe against an onslaught of ever-evolving actors and tactics.

Your Assignment

• Review or conduct regular security and vulnerability assessments leveraging automated and non-automated methods on cloud-based and mobile workloads.

• Periodically monitor/audit implementations and ensure they are functioning properly.

• Identify and advise on technical security requirements, review and approve security architecture and control implementations

• Research security standards/tools

• Develop, update, and/or review Security Assessment Reports

• Develop and tune automated tests and rules, and monitor alerts and alarms for deviations from security standards, particularly using AWS tools such as Inspector, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, GuardDuty, Lambda, and Security Hub.

• Identifying, engineering, and building/updating/integrating new and existing security tooling, including cloud-native services

• Advise project teams on current and projected technical security risks, and recommend mitigation strategies to control risk.

• Assist internal development teams in defining and updating application threat models and in interpreting security policies, standards, and control requirements.

• Design vulnerability scans of cloud-based and mobile applications and infrastructure to identify weaknesses, coordinate with app teams to confirm validity of findings, and recommend and assist with mitigations as needed.

• Work with the security governance team to develop and interpret security standards, and build automated and self-service capabilities that validate application security and compliance status against these standards

• Research and identify best practices to harden and secure cloud workloads including cloud native, containers, and Kubernetes clusters at scale

• Coordinate the work of junior team members performing routine and non-routine tasks within the security program.

• Develop and perform developer-focused training in support of security program goals

• Support the SecOps on call team for incident response

Your Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree or 2-4 years experience in IT / security roles

• 3+ years of experience in AWS or other public cloud environments

• Security+ and/or some other security certifications

• Experience with IAC languages such as YAML, Terraform, and/or CDK.

• Experience with scripting languages and tools (bash, powershell, etc)

• Experience using a modern programming language such as Python, Node.js (preferredD)

• Others (optional): Typescript, GoLang, Java, C#, Rust, etc

• Experience working with software and app teams throughout the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

• Experience with code-defined infrastructure, configuration management tools, and CI/CD

• AWS security tooling for scanning, monitoring and alerting tools (Inspector, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, GuardDuty, Lambda, Security Hub)

Required Technical Qualifications

Platform Architecture Focus:

• End-to-end modern data platform architecture design (lakehouse, ingestion, processing, access layers)

• Experience architecting scalable cloud-native systems (AWS)

• Advanced distributed processing and streaming architectures

• Platform security, networking, and automation

• Cost estimation and performance optimization

Migration & Modernization Architecture Focus:

• Deep expertise in OLTP/OLAP system design and schema evolution

• Advanced performance tuning, HA/DR, and security patterns

• Cloud-native database architecture across managed services

• Migration strategy, cutover planning, and risk mitigation

Across Both:

• IaC and automation strategy (Terraform)

• FinOps-aligned design, including ability to audit and optimize cloud infrastructure expense

• Ability to lead and facilitate technical discussions between key business, technology and knowledge stakeholders

• Ability to develop Databrick roadmaps and implementation roadmaps

• 3+ years designing cloud-based data solutions

• 3+ years in the AWS data landscape

• 3+ years hands-on Databricks experience required

• High business acumen — comfortable working directly with client business stakeholders to understand their data and priorities, and translating that into governed, well-documented platform capabilities

• Advanced English (minimum C1)

• Generous holidays and unlimited flexible PTO

• Paid for exams and certifications

postings.descriptionText:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

As a Senior CXE Engineer, you are a hands-on builder on enterprise contact center transformations. You will spend the majority of your time in code and in the AWS console: building contact flows and AI agents, writing Lambda functions and CDK stacks, developing React-based agent and admin tooling, and debugging production issues on systems that serve tens of thousands of agents and millions of customer interactions. You work within architectures set by practice leads, and you’re expected to pressure-test them, propose better patterns, and own the implementation quality of your workstream from first commit through production cutover. This role blends deep Amazon Connect platform engineering, generative AI development on Bedrock and Claude, and full-stack serverless work, with regular direct interaction with customer engineering teams.

Your Assignment

AI Agent & Conversational AI Development

• Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues

• Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops

• Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis

• Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets

• Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues

• Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions

Amazon Connect Platform Engineering

• Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing

• Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)

• Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management

• Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)

• Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting

• Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers

Full-Stack & Portal Engineering

• Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)

• Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration

• Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements

Infrastructure, Delivery & Quality

• Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances

• Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring

• Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage

• Apply security and compliance baselines in everything you ship: least-privilege IAM, DevSecOps scanning, encryption standards

Collaboration & Practice Contribution

• Work directly with customer engineering teams: pair on integrations, run technical working sessions, demo completed workstreams, and lead knowledge transfer so customers can operate what you build

We are seeking a Manager, Data Platform to lead the team that builds and operates the foundation every other data team depends on. This role is accountable for the infrastructure, capabilities, and tooling that make our data platform observable, reliable, cost-efficient, and ready to scale with current and future traffic. You will translate platform strategy into a clear roadmap, establish owners and deadlines, and deliver measurable improvements in reliability, visibility, and efficiency. You will partner closely with Data, ML/AI, and Product Engineers, Data Scientists, Security, and Privacy teams to manage risks and dependencies and make clear trade-off decisions. You will also hire, coach, and develop engineers while partnering with Staff+ engineers and architects on technical direction. Success will be measured by platform reliability and scalability, cost transparency and efficiency, team health, and the productivity of the teams who build on the platform.

Candidates considered for this role will be located in Buenos Aires, Argentina. There will be an in-office requirement of 3x a week.

The Job

• Own the Platform Roadmap & Outcomes: Partner with data product management to build the team's roadmap and backlog, tying platform investments to measurable outcomes such as reliability, scalability, cost savings, and developer productivity.

• Build Observability into the Platform: Lead the design and delivery of monitoring, alerting, and observability capabilities, including pipeline health, data freshness and quality signals, distributed tracing, SLOs/SLAs, and incident detection, so issues are found before our stakeholders find them.

• Deliver Cost Visibility & Optimization: Build the tooling and practices that give teams clear attribution of compute, storage, and pipeline spend. Drive FinOps habits such as budgets, anomaly detection, and efficiency targets without sacrificing reliability.

• Scale for Current & Future Demand: Own capacity planning, performance engineering, and architecture evolution so batch and streaming systems handle growth, seasonal spikes, and viral fundraising moments.

• Build Self-Service Tooling & Paved Roads: Create reusable frameworks, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, orchestration standards, and templates that let data teams ship quickly, safely, and consistently.

• Drive Reliability & Operational Excellence: Establish on-call practices, incident response, postmortems, runbooks, and sustainable support models. Use operational metrics to continuously improve.

• Partner Cross-Functionally: Build strong relationships with Data, ML/AI, and Product Engineers, Data Scientists, Security, and Privacy teams to understand platform needs and communicate priorities, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly.

• Drive Delivery & Accountability: Set clear owners, milestones, and deadlines; hold the team accountable for commitments; and communicate progress and decisions transparently.

• Lead, Grow & Manage Performance: Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team through regular feedback, 1:1s, performance management, and meaningful career development.

• Manage Risks & Dependencies: Proactively identify and resolve delivery risks, cross-team dependencies, migration challenges, and blockers before they affect outcomes.

• Make Prioritization & Trade-Off Decisions: Balance new capabilities against reliability, security, cost, technical debt, and team capacity, and explain the rationale clearly.

• Partner on Technical Direction: Work with Staff+ engineers and architects to align architecture and tooling decisions with business priorities and long-term platform strategy.

• Improve Team Efficiency with AI: Champion responsible use of AI tools and agents in platform operations (anomaly detection, incident triage, cost analysis), development, and documentation.

You

• Have excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to build trust, align diverse stakeholders, navigate conflict, and communicate priorities, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly.

• Bring 5+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, SRE, or related fields, including at least 2+ years directly managing engineers or platform teams.

• Have a track record of driving predictable delivery, establishing clear ownership and deadlines, and holding teams accountable for commitments.

• Have proven success hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering teams.

• Show strong judgment in prioritization, resource allocation, risk management, and making difficult trade-off decisions.

You will work across engineering, privacy, and compliance, partnering with Legal & Privacy to translate regulatory requirements into durable, production-grade services. That means building the systems that execute data subject requests, enforce data classification across our data ecosystem, and propagate consent signals from capture through every downstream system.

If you enjoy building reliable, auditable systems under real regulatory pressure and getting the edge cases right, this role is for you.

This is a hybrid position. Candidates considered for this role will be located in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

You'll build DSR handling pipelines that are auditable, resumable, and idempotent, and that can retry safely from an inconsistent state and hold up against third-party API timeouts, partial writes, and stalled event consumers.

• Own access, deletion, and objection processes at the data layer: Maintain and extend the scripts and workflows that carry out individual-level privacy requests across our data warehouse, handling edge cases like legal holds, financial data exemptions, and users who appear across multiple systems under different identifiers.

• Build the systems that classify and protect personal data: Classify and tag personal and sensitive data, and enforce sensitivity tiers across our data catalog. Apply the right redaction method for the situation (e.g., hard delete, nullify, pseudonymize), using approved tokenization and encryption services where policy requires them.

• Drive consent signal propagation: Make sure consent state travels correctly from capture (analytics, retargeting, model training opt-outs, email subscription statuses) through tag managers, event pipelines, and downstream systems such as ad platforms, CDPs, and the data warehouse. Identify and close gaps where a signal is captured but doesn't reach a downstream system, or isn't honored end-to-end across web, mobile, email, and server-to-server channels. Help design and build a centralized consent source of truth.

• Partner on consent management platform (CMP) operations: Work with Pro PMs and Engineering on release management, QA, and production troubleshooting for our CMP across Consumer and Pro instances.

• Build privacy in early: Turn privacy requirements into concrete engineering decisions that support Privacy by Design. Bring them into product development and security engineering reviews, and know when to escalate together with Legal & Privacy.

• Produce technical compliance evidence: Generate the coverage reports, logs, and documentation that support internal privacy-compliance reviews and external audits.

• Use AI to increase engineering impact: Integrate AI-assisted tools and coding agents into your day-to-day workflow to deliver more than traditional development practices alone would allow. Use them to accelerate prototyping, implementation, test generation, debugging, data investigation, documentation, and repetitive engineering work, while holding to our standards for accuracy, maintainability, security, and code review.

• Strong programming: Fluency in a general-purpose language (Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, or similar) for ETL, redaction scripts, pre-flight checks, and coverage reporting, including integrating with external vendor REST APIs (authentication, error handling, rate limiting).

• Reliable, long-running workflows: Experience designing or maintaining multi-step pipelines with independent failure modes, including checkpointing, resumability, and idempotent retries. Incident debugging and ownership: Experience driving a real incident to resolution independently, including one where a pipeline left data partially processed and you reconstructed ground truth from logs, database state, or audit trails. • Collaborate closely with Composer and AI/KB teams on execution semantics and runtime behavior.

• Strong production Kotlin backend experience.
• Strong Spring Boot experience in distributed systems or platform services.
• Hands-on Temporal experience in production.
• Strong understanding of workflow durability, retries, idempotency, and recovery design.
• Experience with multi-module Gradle codebases and contract-first API design.
• Experience with JPA/Hibernate and PostgreSQL.

• Comfort debugging multi-service systems with mixed Kotlin and Python components.
• Experience with observability tools like micrometer
• Experience with contract first development

Job Description: AI Business Consultant

Propósito

Transformar problemas de negocio complejos en soluciones de tecnología e IA viables, construibles y adoptables.
Liderar el proceso desde el discovery y diseño de la solución hasta su validación mediante MVP/POC, acompañando el delivery para asegurar que la solución mantenga el foco en los outcomes de negocio esperados.

• Business Consulting

Liderar discoveries con clientes para comprender problemas, procesos, stakeholders e impacto esperado. Estructurar problemas ambiguos, identificar oportunidades y definir el business case, outcomes y métricas de éxito.

Transformar necesidades de negocio en una propuesta de valor y una solución concreta. Definir hipótesis, alcance, MVP, roadmap y criterios de éxito, priorizando según impacto, viabilidad y time-to-value.

Acompañar el delivery de la solución diseñada, gestionando definiciones funcionales y prioridades de producto junto al equipo. Mantener la conexión entre el problema, la solución y la ejecución, detectando desvíos respecto de los outcomes definidos.

● Develop new offer types and enhancements, partnering with middleware and front-end web/app teams.

● Prior Databricks / lakehouse migration experience strongly preferred — this is a key evaluation criterion.
● Comfortable working directly with business stakeholders (CRM, Marketing, Analytics), not just ticket-based execution.

● Advanced English requiered.

postings.descriptionText:
Rol: Technical Delivery Lead / Staff Architect

Reporta a: VP LATAM

Departamento: Delivery

Alcance: Delivery, transversal a todos los proyectos y equipos técnicos de LATAM

Ubicación: Córdoba o CABA (Argentina)

Modalidad: Híbrida (presencialidad mínima requerida 6 veces al mes)

Propósito del Rol

Garantizar la excelencia técnica del portfolio de LATAM, actuando como el socio técnico estratégico (Technical Partner) del Delivery Manager. Este rol lidera la viabilidad de las soluciones, la adopción de prácticas de desarrollo asistido por IA y la excelencia operativa. Es el puente donde la estrategia técnica (Architect) se materializa en resultados de negocio (Delivery), asegurando escalabilidad, innovación y calidad en cada proyecto.

Estrategia y Responsabilidades Críticas

1) Sinergia y Technical Partnering

Colaboración estrecha con los Delivery Managers y Project Managers en la definición de Account Plans, aportando la visión técnica a largo plazo, validando la factibilidad de las propuestas comerciales (Upselling/Cross-selling) y gestionando técnicamente los escalamientos de alta criticidad para asegurar la continuidad del negocio, integrando en esta labor un alto dominio de soluciones enterprise, data e AI como eje fundamental del offering de Santex.

2) Rollout y Evolución de Procesos Agénticos

Liderar el despliegue y la evolución continua de los workflows agénticos, integrando aprendizajes obtenidos para optimizar el SDLC de forma permanente. Es un requisito excluyente que este rol actúe como referente interno de agentización e impulse el uso intensivo de AI-assisted development. Responsable de ayudar a Delivery a implementar y medir la eficiencia operativa derivada del uso intensivo de la IA, asegurando mejoras de productividad sin detrimento de la calidad técnica.

3) Monitoreo de buenas prácticas de desarrollo

Asegurar que los equipos de Delivery apliquen de forma consistente las buenas prácticas de desarrollo definidas por la organización: calidad del código, pruebas, documentación, seguridad y uso adecuado de las herramientas. Detectar desvíos tempranamente y accionarlos, comenzando por anticiparse a las no conformidades críticas.

4) Intervención técnica en proyectos

Actuar como punto de escalada técnica ante problemas complejos en proyectos: bloqueantes de arquitectura, decisiones críticas de diseño, conflictos tecnológicos o situaciones de riesgo técnico. Intervenir con criterio y rapidez para desbloquear equipos y proteger la calidad de la entrega.

5) Generación proactiva de soluciones en Pre-sales

Actuar como generador proactivo de propuestas de solución técnica. Basándose en un profundo entendimiento de las necesidades, desafíos y oportunidades del cliente, diseña estrategias tecnológicas que impulsen su negocio, superando el rol de soporte reactivo y posicionándose como consultor técnico estratégico que aporta valor incremental. Asegurando que dichas propuestas estén fundamentadas en el alto dominio de soluciones enterprise, data e AI, posicionándolas como el core del offering de valor de Santex.

6) Setup de equipos e inicio de proyectos críticos

Asistir activamente a los Delivery Managers en la conformación y configuración de los equipos de ingeniería para afrontar nuevos proyectos. Esto incluye apoyar a Delivery en los procesos de screening técnico.

Acompañar el despliegue de las bases y el framework de trabajo durante las etapas iniciales para garantizar un arranque sólido y exitoso del proyecto.

Apoyar a los managers en la identificación de las oportunidades de desarrollo de los líderes técnicos de cada equipo.

7) Input para la matriz de desarrollo de personas

Aportar criterio técnico a la matriz de desarrollo individual del área de Delivery: identificar brechas de habilidades, proponer niveles de seniority esperados por rol y tecnología, y definir los hitos técnicos que los colaboradores deben alcanzar en su plan de carrera.

Funciones Esenciales

• Gestión Agéntica: Iterar workflows basándose en métricas, liderar el AI Tech Board y medir la eficiencia operativa (productivity gains vs. quality).

• Intervención Técnica: Resolver bloqueos de arquitectura, performance o deuda técnica, actuando como punto de escalada técnica.

• Pre-sales Proactivo: Realizar Discovery técnico, diseñar soluciones, y estimar recursos para asegurar la viabilidad comercial y técnica de las propuestas.

• Monitoreo de Buenas Prácticas: Auditar calidad mediante revisiones, métricas (GitHub, etc.) y planes de mejora.

• Screening y Setup: Apoyar a Delivery en el screening técnico y configurar las bases sólidas para el arranque de proyectos críticos.

KPIs de Éxito

• Eficiencia Operativa: % de incremento en productividad mediante IA sin detrimento de la calidad técnica (defect rate).

• Excelencia Técnica: Reducción de incidentes post-entrega y deuda técnica en proyectos clave.

• Liderazgo de Talento: Progreso técnico de los equipos supervisados (brechas de habilidades cerradas).

• Impacto Comercial: Tasa de conversión y valor incremental en propuestas de pre-sales.

Qualifications

• Formación académica en ingeniería de software o afines.

• Experiencia como Arquitecto de Software, Staff Engineer, Technical Manager o Engineer Manager.

postings.title: High-Speed Analog Layout Design Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Celero Communications is a fast-growing semiconductor startup developing high-performance coherent DSP technology for next-generation AI infrastructure. We recently announced a $275M Series C following the validation of the industry’s first 2nm coherent DSP silicon. Bloomberg also reported that Alphabet’s CapitalG has backed Celero at a $3B valuation. As we continue to grow, we’re hiring exceptional talent across the United States, Canada, and Argentina for a variety of exciting opportunities.

We are seeking a High-Speed Analog Layout Design Engineer to drive the layout design of complex analog and mixed-signal IP blocks that are at the heart of our advanced optical communication systems. As a key member of the Analog & Mixed-Signal (AMS) design team, you will lead layout development of critical blocks such as ADCs, DACs, PLLs, and other high-performance analog/mixed-signal circuits. You will interface closely with circuit designers, CAD/PDK teams, and other layout engineers to ensure first-pass silicon success. This is a hands-on technical role ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys mentoring others while contributing directly to cutting-edge chip development.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead and own the physical layout design of complex analog/mixed-signal macros (e.g., ADCs, DACs, PLLs), from floor planning through final verification
• Collaborate closely with schematic designers to create optimal layout solutions considering performance, matching, symmetry, and reliability
• Mentor and guide junior layout engineers/contractors across multiple time zones, enforcing best practices in layout design and verification
• Perform and debug full hierarchy LVS, DRC, PERC, ERC, and other signoff checks using industry-standard tools (Pegasus, Calibre, etc.)
• Contribute to chip-level planning including top-level floor planning, block integration, power grid implementation, and signal routing
• Participate in layout design reviews and provide technical leadership for layout quality, verification completeness, and schedule adherence
• Support automation initiatives through scripting and tool customization (SKILL, TCL, Python is a plus)

Required Qualifications
• Minimum 1+ years of hands-on analog/mixed-signal layout design experience and in advanced CMOS/FinFET technologies
• Proven track record of top-level integration IP layout macros and preparing IPs for handoff to Physical Design
• Proven leadership in owning major IP layout macros or full-chip-level layout at FinFET nodes (TSMC preferred)
• At least 1+ years of experience with TSMC FinFET process nodes (N3, N5, N7, or N16)
• Deep understanding of device physics, layout-dependent effects (LOD, WPE, OSE, LDE, etc.), and their impact on circuit performance
• Strong expertise in layout best practices for device matching, noise isolation, ESD protection, symmetry, and parasitic minimization
• Proficiency in floor planning, hierarchical block integration, routing strategy, and power/ground grid design
• Expertise with Cadence Virtuoso, Calibre, Pegasus, and other layout and verification tools
• Familiarity with layout verification flows, including LVS, DRC, PERC, Density, DFM, ERC, and Antenna rules
• Experience working in collaborative environments with international and remote teams
• Strong documentation and communication skills with the ability to clearly present layout trade-offs and status to cross-functional teams
• Experience using revision control systems for layout design management

Preferred Qualifications
• Exposure to optical or high-speed analog interfaces is a strong plus
• Working knowledge of SKILL, TCL, or Python for layout automation or design flow optimization
• Proven ability to collaborate with international teams (U.S., Canada, Argentina)
• Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail and follow-through
• Ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
• Proactive, eager-to-learn mindset with excellent problem-solving skills

What We Offer
• The chance to play a foundational role at a high-growth semiconductor start-up
• Exposure to a wide variety of cross functional teams
• A collaborative, international team culture where ideas and initiative are valued
• The opportunity to grow alongside Celero as we scale and shape the future of our industry
• A foundational role at a fast-growing semiconductor start-up shaping the future of AI and data center connectivity

postings.title: AI Workflow Engineer | LATAM
postings.descriptionText:
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking an AI Workflow Engineer !

About the Role:

Backblaze is running a company-wide AI transformation program, and this role is where strategy becomes something you can actually use. As AI Workflow Engineer, you will be the hands-on builder inside the AI Program Office - embedded alongside the Director, AI Enablement, and deployed into non-GTM, non-Engineering business teams to prototype, build, and ship AI-powered workflow solutions that make a measurable difference in how work gets done.

This is not a research role or a strategy role. You will spend your time building: prompt architectures, automation flows, lightweight agents, API integrations, and demos that help a business team see - concretely - what AI can do for them. You will move across functions, which means you need to understand how businesses actually operate. The ideal background is someone who started in a business-facing role - finance, operations, marketing, customer success, HR - and developed serious hands-on AI and automation skills on top of that foundation.

You will work closely with the Director, AI Enablement, who owns the program management and delivery layer. Your job is to make their scoped solutions real - fast, iteratively, and with enough rigor that what you build can go to production.

What You Will Do:

Build and Ship AI Workflow Solutions

• Take scoped use cases from the Director, AI Enablement and build working solutions: prompt layers, automation flows, lightweight agents, RAG implementations, and API integrations that connect AI tools to the systems business teams already use

• Build working prototypes quickly - the goal is to show a team what is possible in days, not weeks, then refine based on what actually lands

• Translate a documented workflow assessment into a technical design, select the right tools for the job, and own the build through to a deployable solution

• Maintain solution documentation that is clear enough for handoff, iteration, and audit - not just for engineers, but for the business owner who will live with it

Embed in Business Teams

• Spend time inside the functions you are building for - Finance, HR, Legal, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and others - understanding how the work actually flows before you redesign it

• Run working sessions with team members to map current-state workflows, surface friction points, and identify where AI creates real leverage versus where it creates noise

• Build credibility with non-technical stakeholders by showing them working solutions, not decks - and by being honest about what will and will not work

• Support user acceptance testing and early adoption, troubleshooting issues close to launch and iterating based on real usage

Support the AI Program Office

• Build demos and proof-of-concepts that help the Director, AI Enablement make the case for a use case - or disqualify it early before resources are committed

• Contribute to vendor and tool evaluations with a builder's perspective: not just whether a tool claims to do something, but whether it actually works in the context of a specific workflow

• Feed learnings from the build process back into the program - what worked, what did not, what should be standardized across functions

• Work on tactical quick wins and longer-horizon strategic builds at the same time, switching contexts across active use cases as priorities shift

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• You have completed at least one workflow assessment alongside the Director and produced a working prototype from it

• At least one solution you built is in active use by a business team, with a named owner and feedback loop in place

• You have worked inside at least two different business functions and understand their core workflows well enough to identify the next use case without being told

• The Director, AI Enablement trusts you to own the build layer independently - scoping conversations happen together, execution happens with you driving

The Right Fit:

• 2-4 years of experience that includes meaningful time working inside a business-facing function - operations, finance, marketing, customer success, HR, or similar - not just in Engineering or IT

• Hands-on experience building with AI tools: prompt engineering, automation platforms (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent), API integrations, and at least working familiarity with RAG architectures and agent frameworks

• Proven ability to take a messy real-world process, understand it from the inside, and build something that makes it faster or better - not just technically cleaner

• Comfortable working with non-technical stakeholders: you can explain what you are building without jargon, gather requirements without a formal spec, and manage expectations when a prototype needs three more iterations

• Strong enough with code or no-code tools to get solutions to a deployable state independently - you do not need an engineer to ship your work

• Able to manage multiple active projects at different stages without dropping anything - a quick win in HR…

postings.descriptionText:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $136M ARR and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Sr. Reliability Engineer ll (DBA) to join our team!

About the Role

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) with a DBA (Database Administration) focus to help ensure the stability, scalability, and reliability of our production database systems - primarily Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra - alongside the rest of our services and infrastructure. This role operates within procedures and runbooks established by our senior DBA SREs, and focuses on building automation, maintaining observability, and supporting incident response to keep customer-facing systems performing at their best.

The SRE will collaborate with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed reliability practices into day-to-day development and operations while contributing to tools and processes that improve efficiency and reduce manual effort

Key Responsibilities

Database Administration

• Operating and maintaining high-availability database systems — primarily Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra — against established architecture and runbooks.

• Optimizing database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and schema design.

• Executing documented backup, recovery, and replication procedures to ensure data durability; escalating architecture-level changes to senior DBA SREs.

• Ensuring database security compliance and access control.

Service Reliability & Operations

• Support the availability and durability of critical services across production environments.

• Monitor service health using SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and escalate issues when thresholds are at risk.

• Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews to drive service improvements.

• Follow established ITIL/OSS processes (incident, change, problem, and capacity management).

Automation & Tooling

• Develop automation for common operational tasks, reducing manual intervention and toil.

• Contribute to monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Catchpoint, ELK), and help integrate runbooks with FireHydrant.

• Work with CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins).

• Write scripts (Bash, Python, Go, etc.) to improve system reliability and efficiency.

Collaboration

• Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams to support resilient system design and operations.

• Assist in capacity planning and disaster recovery exercises.

• Work with vendors and service providers to troubleshoot service issues and track SLA performance.

• Document systems, share learnings, and help grow a reliability-minded engineering culture.

Continuous Improvement

• Contribute to playbooks, runbooks, and operational documentation.

• Identify recurring issues and propose long-term improvements.

• Promote reliability-focused practices within development and operations teams.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• 2–4 years of experience in site reliability, systems engineering, or operations centered around database systems.

• Exposure to large-scale, production-grade systems. This is a Level 2 role executing established database operations procedures — architecture and design ownership sits with our Level 3 DBA SREs.

Technical Skills

• Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.

• Familiarity with service reliability concepts - monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis.

• Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or Go).

• Understanding of containers (Kubernetes, Docker) and microservices concepts; comfort operating in a Kubernetes/Vitess-on-K8s environment (kubectl, mysqlsh, Vitess keyspaces) is a plus.

• Knowledge of incident response and operational best practices.

• Hands-on experience with MySQL performance tuning, replication, and disaster recovery; direct experience with Vitess or other distributed/sharded MySQL systems is a plus, but not required — strong MySQL fundamentals matter most.

• Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL database management.

Preferred Attributes

• Experience in a SaaS, service provider, or distributed systems environment.

• Familiarity with ITIL/OSS practices and SLO/SLA’s

• Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive projects from problem discovery through resolution.
