postings.title: Sr. AI Security Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking a Sr. AI Security Engineer to join our team!

About The Role

Backblaze is seeking a Senior AI Security Engineer to design and implement safeguards for internal AI usage , with a focus on agentic systems, developer protection, and runtime security .

This is a hands-on role for a practitioner who has built and deployed security controls , not just defined policy. You will enable teams to safely use AI by creating enforcement layers, identity controls, and detection capabilities that constrain and monitor AI-driven activity.

What You’ll Do:

Agentic AI Safeguards

• Architect and implement guardrails for tool-using AI systems , including:

• Tool access controls and allowlists

• Context and memory isolation

• Step-level validation of agent actions

• Apply mitigations aligned to the OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (e.g., prompt injection, unsafe tool use, data leakage, excessive autonomy)

Runtime Security Controls

• Build enforcement mechanisms that govern AI behavior at execution time:

• Interceptors, proxies, or middleware for tool/API calls

• Policy decision and enforcement layers

• Rate limits, execution bounds, and kill-switches

• Prevent unsafe or unauthorized actions initiated by AI systems

Non-Human Identity (NHI)

• Design and implement identity and access controls for agents and automation , including:

• Short-lived credentials and scoped permissions

• Clear separation between human and non-human access

• Strong binding of identity to task context and execution

• Ensure all AI actions are attributable and auditable

Observability & Detection

• Implement logging and tracing for AI activity :

• Prompts, tool usage, and decision flows

• Build detection capabilities using:

• Behavioral baselining and anomaly detection techniques

• Identify and alert on:

• Abnormal tool usage

• Suspicious prompt patterns

• Unexpected data access

Threat Modeling (MAESTRO)

• Perform agentic system threat modeling using MAESTRO , including:

• Mapping agent capabilities, trust boundaries, and attack paths

• Modeling misuse and adversarial scenarios

• Translate findings into practical safeguards and detection logic

Developer Safeguards

• Protect developers using AI tools by:

• Preventing sensitive data exposure

• Validating AI-generated code and actions

• Constraining unsafe automation

• Enable safe usage of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor ) with:

• Security validation layers

• Controlled prompting and output handling patterns

The Right Fit:

• 7+ years in security engineering or backend systems

• Proven experience designing and deploying security controls , such as:

• Runtime enforcement layers (proxies, middleware, policy engines)

• Identity and access systems, especially for non-human entities

• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; Go, Java, or TypeScript a plus)

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code in real workflows, including understanding associated security risks and safeguards

• Experience with:

• Logging, monitoring, and detection systems

• Building or securing API/service interactions

• Practical familiarity with:

• Agentic AI systems or tool-integrated LLM workflows

• OWASP guidance for AI/agent risks

Practitioner Knowledge

• Experience applying (not just referencing):

• OWASP Agentic AI / LLM risk guidance

• NIST AI RMF concepts in real systems

• CSA guidance on workload and machine identity

• Strong understanding of:

• Zero Trust for non-human identities

• Secrets management and credential scoping

• Observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, ELK)

Bonus Points For:

• Experience securing internal AI platforms or developer-facing AI tools

• Background in detection engineering, threat hunting, or adversarial testing

• Familiarity with agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex)

• Experience mentoring engineers and guiding secure design

At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you're reading. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Learning, developing, and growing are key parts of our culture. We're eager to meet people who believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in various ways. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries, but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Desktop & End-User Support

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, knowledge-base articles, and standard operating procedures.

Sr. Director of Commercial and Legal Affairs

About Backblaze

Backblaze is a public company that makes storing and using data astonishingly easy. When our founding team got together, they committed to helping people save their data. Today, the Backblaze Storage Cloud provides a foundational platform around the world for a broad community of developers, IT generalists, entrepreneurs, and individuals who seek the easy, affordable, trusted solutions we provide.

We have managed to nurture a team-oriented culture with amazingly low turnover. Our approach is guided by honesty, transparency, and a commitment to doing the right thing. Our customers are happy, and so are our coworkers: in the most recent “Great Place to Work” survey, 97% of our team rated Backblaze as “a great place to work.” Check out what our employees are saying on Glassdoor!

About the Role

We are seeking a Sr. Director of Commercial and Legal Affairs to lead and oversee Backblaze’s commercial, privacy, and product legal functions. This is a people leader role that will serve as a strategic business partner across Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, and Compliance.

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced commercial lawyer with a strong track record of drafting and negotiating complex technology transactions, including enterprise and strategic partnership deals. This role also requires fluency in privacy and data protection issues and hands-on experience advising product and engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.

This position will play a critical role in enabling scalable growth while thoughtfully managing legal and regulatory risk as Backblaze continues to expand globally. This role includes people management responsibilities and will lead, mentor, and develop attorney(s) and legal professional(s) supporting commercial, privacy, and product work.

This role reports to the Head of Legal & Compliance and is fully remote (US-based).

Commercial Leadership and Deal Execution

• Lead the company’s commercial contracting function, serving as the primary legal owner for complex, high-value, and strategic transactions.

• Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of sophisticated commercial agreements, including enterprise SaaS agreements, MSAs, SOWs, partnership and channel agreements, reseller agreements, professional services agreements, consulting agreements, and related technology transactions.

• Act as the senior escalation point for complex or high-risk negotiations, providing strategic guidance to Sales, Business Development, and executive stakeholders.

• Ensure commercial terms align with Backblaze’s business objectives, risk tolerance, and long-term growth strategy.

Privacy and Data Protection

• Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice on global privacy and data protection matters, including GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable data protection regimes.

• Oversee and support the development, negotiation, and maintenance of data protection agreements, privacy terms, and related contractual frameworks.

• Partner closely with Security, Compliance, and Product teams to assess privacy risk and ensure data protection obligations are integrated into business processes and products.

Product and AI Counseling

• Serve as a trusted legal advisor to Product and Engineering teams, advising on product design, feature development, and launches from inception through release.

• Counsel on issues related to data use, AI and machine learning, intellectual property, open source, and regulatory considerations impacting product development.

• Advise on the commercial, privacy, and contractual terms for AI features and AI-driven workloads, and help the business adopt AI responsibly and at speed.

• Help teams identify and mitigate legal risk while enabling innovation and speed.

Process, Playbooks, and Scale

• Lead the development and continuous improvement of commercial playbooks, templates, policies, and negotiation frameworks to support efficient scaling.

• Optimize contracting processes to improve speed, consistency, and quality while maintaining appropriate controls, including through the use of AI-enabled contracting and legal tooling.

• Partner with Legal Operations to enhance tooling, workflows, and reporting related to commercial and privacy matters.

• Stay current on legal and regulatory developments relevant to cloud services, SaaS, privacy, AI, and technology transactions.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Act as a trusted partner to Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Security, and other cross-functional teams.

• Provide training and guidance to internal stakeholders on contracting best practices, privacy requirements, and risk awareness.

• Collaborate closely with other Legal and Compliance leaders to ensure alignment across the broader legal function.

People Leadership and Team Development

• Lead and manage legal professionals supporting commercial, privacy, and product counseling functions.

• Provide mentorship, coaching, and performance management to support professional growth and high-quality legal work.

• Set clear priorities, allocate work effectively, and ensure consistent, high-impact legal support across the business.

• Partner with members of the Legal & Compliance team, as well as senior leadership, on team planning, resourcing, and process improvements as the function scales.

The Right Fit

• Deep experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements, including enterprise customer and strategic partnership transactions.

• Strong understanding of SaaS business models, cloud services, and technology transactions.

postings.title: Attorney Development Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Location: 100 % remote Contract:   Full-time, Independent Contractor     Posting   Jurisdictions :   To support US Eastern Time working hours      

Our Firm:

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economics as well as the legal aspects of our matters.
Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

Learn more at: www.sterlingtonlaw.com/

The Opportunity

As the firm scales, our associates need people management, feedback that helps them grow, and a real sense of belonging .

You'll own attorney development from the ground up. You'll build the feedback cadence, development programs, and sense of community that turns associates into long-term, fully utilized members of the firm.

Success at six months looks like associates who feel part of something bigger, are receiving real and consistent feedback, and are growing, reflected in stronger utilization. From there, the ambition grows: measurably better associate engagement and the launch of programs to enhance our attorneys’ experience at Sterlington .

You'll join the People Team and work closely with firm leadership.

What You'll Do:

• Build a feedback cadence. Built around our firm-wide culture of feedback, support team members in receiving the feedback they need to propel their growth, not just an annual review.

• Manage stakeholder relationships. Work closely with partners and firm leadership, tailoring your approach to each; this isn't a one-size-fits-all function.

• Create a sense of community. Develop the programs and touchpoints that make associates feel like they belong to the firm, not just assigned to it.

• Own learning & development. Design and manage L&D programs end-to-end, course design grounded in adult learning theory, that build associates' skills and support their career progression.

• Coach and mentor. Work directly with associates as a people manager: coach individuals, resolve performance concerns, and help them navigate their development.

• Use data to drive decisions. Analyze utilization and performance data to identify where associates are under- or mis-utilized and turn that into action.

• Bring a point of view on talent. Contribute to talent acquisition efforts, including future programs that grow our attorney team, and apply a working knowledge of US employment law where it touches development and performance.

• Speak with authority. Represent attorney development as a real function within the firm: confidently, directly, and with the credibility to influence how the firm thinks about its people.

What We're Looking For :

• A legal or attorney-development background. Ideally, you've done this work inside a law firm or legal tech environment. You understand what makes attorneys tick, and what "development" actually means in that context.

• This role calls for judgment rather than years served. You'll need to step into ambiguous situations, identify what's missing, prioritize it, and work the room to make it happen .

• Strong L&D program design skills. You know how to build training grounded in adult learning theory to achieve your objectives, not just schedule sessions.

• Real coaching and mentoring experience. Ideally, you've been a people manager before. This role is about developing people directly, not just administering a program.

• Working knowledge of US employment law. Not a legal expert, but comfortable enough to know when something needs a closer look.

• A data-driven streak. Comfortable pulling together utilization and performance data to spot problems and make the case for action.

• Excellent English communication. Written and verbal. You'll be coaching attorneys and influencing leadership, so this needs to be a strength, not a gap.

• Americas time zone, ideally ET. You'll need real overlap with the team and the attorneys you're supporting.

• The right temperament. People who thrive here don't wait to be told what to do. They're resilient, direct, transparent, and genuinely want to be part of a team. Comfort with ambiguity is table stakes, and being AI-forward and tech-savvy is essential.

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Billing Specialist to take ownership of invoicing and billing operations in a fast-paced, client-facing environment. This role sits at the center of revenue operations, working closely with partners, finance, and client teams to ensure invoices are accurate, timely, and aligned with client expectations.

You’ll play a key role in keeping billing clean, reducing friction with clients, and supporting overall cash flow.

What You'll Do:

• Prepare, review, and issue invoices accurately and on time, including billable hours and client-specific billing arrangements

• Work closely with partners and internal stakeholders to validate billing details before sending invoices

• Track billing schedules and ensure deadlines are consistently met

• Review time entries, expenses, and billing data to ensure accuracy and compliance

• Resolve billing queries and disputes by coordinating with internal teams and communicating with clients

• Maintain clean and organized billing records and documentation

• Support month-end processes by ensuring billing data is complete and up to date

• Identify recurring billing issues and suggest practical improvements to processes

• 2–5+ years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, or finance operations

• Familiarity with AI-assisted billing tools: comfortable using AI features in accounting or ERP platforms to flag anomalies, automate invoice matching, or surface overdue accounts faster

• Open to AI-augmented workflows: willing to adopt AI tools that streamline repetitive tasks like data entry, payment follow-ups, or reconciliation, freeing up time for higher-value problem-solving

• Strong attention to detail; you catch errors before they become problems

• Comfortable working with different billing structures (hourly, fixed fee, retainers)

• Clear communicator, able to follow up, clarify, and resolve issues quickly

• Organized and able to manage multiple invoices and deadlines at once

• Experience with accounting or billing systems (ERP, legal billing tools, etc.)

• Solid Excel skills and confidence working with data

postings.title: Business Operations Manager
postings.descriptionText:
Reports to: Head of Ops
Location: 100 % remote
Department: Legal Administration
Type: Independent Contractor

Our Firm:

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economic as well as the legal aspects of our matters.
Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

Learn more at: www.sterlingtonlaw.com/

The Opportunity

Sterlington is looking for a Business Operations Manager to implement AI workflows and run the execution layer of the Head of Firm Management's portfolio. The Head of Firm Management leads the firm and sits on its management committee, and the portfolio spans every function: strategy, partner matters, planning cycles, firm-wide initiatives and external relationships. This role sits at the center of that portfolio, ensuring that priorities are visible, decisions are made on time, and commitments are delivered without friction.

You will be accountable for what reaches the Head of Firm Management and what is resolved before it does. That means holding a live view of every open commitment across the portfolio, converting a continuous inbound flow into a ranked and decided list, and closing out what does not require her. Where the cadence for a workstream does not yet exist, you will design it in partnership with the Head of Operations so that it is consistent with how the rest of the firm runs.You will ensure that the operational dimension of the firm's leadership is reliable, anticipatory, and unobtrusive, working in alignment with the broader support infrastructure of the firm, never duplicating it.

What You'll Do:

• AI-Driven Process Innovation: Drive continuous improvement by refining workflows for greater efficiency and scalability, integrating AI tools in a measured, high-judgment manner to enhance tracking, summarization, briefing preparation and internal coordination.

• Demand and Priority Management: Own the inbound flow of partner requests, firm issues and external approaches. Decide what reaches the Head of Firm Management, what is redirected, and what is closed out, with a reason attached to every call.

• Leadership Operating Rhythm: Run the cadence of firm leadership: management committee preparation, planning cycles, leadership meetings and reviews. Translate the firm's planning and reporting cycles into a working rhythm for the portfolio, and design what does not yet exist.

• Decision Support: Prepare concise, decision-ready briefings, committee papers and status summaries that allow the Head of Firm Management to act quickly and with confidence, then drive execution on those decisions.

• Stakeholder Management: Coordinate across partners, senior lawyers, business services and external parties, serving as the primary liaison on her behalf, driving follow-through, accountability and timely escalation where needed.

• Execution Ownership: Take initiatives she does not have the capacity to run, own them end to end, and report on them once rather than continuously.

• Risk Mitigation: Anticipate gaps, misalignments and potential delays, and resolve them before they surface.

What We're Looking For :

• Experience in business operations, chief of staff, strategy or operations roles working directly to a senior leader, with the authority to act rather than to relay

• A track record of creating a way of working rather than inheriting one, inside someone else's framework rather than around it

• Judgment you can explain: a method for deciding on another person's behalf, including declining requests from senior people while keeping the relationship intact

• Professional services, law firm or equivalent complex stakeholder environment is a strong plus

• Native or full professional English fluency required

• Structured, systems-oriented mindset: you introduce clarity without over-engineering

• Discretion and composure. You will hold the firm's most sensitive information

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

postings.descriptionText:
Contract: Full-time, Independent Contractor

Location: Remote — we hire across multiple jurisdictions

Hours: US Eastern Time - This role covers weekends only, 9am to 5pm ET.

Our Firm

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economic as well as the legal aspects of our matters. Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

We are remote-first, and our support teams work as one global Legal Operations function across multiple time zones.

Learn more at www.sterlingtonlaw.com

The Opportunity

We are looking for a first-class Legal Practice Assistant to provide white glove support service to our firm’s partners and attorneys. By gaining a deep understanding of each partner’s practice, you will support them to execute on client matters, run the administrative engine behind the work, coordinate with stakeholders across the firm, and help ensure our business and our clients’ goals are achieved.

We are looking for someone who is curious and practical in using AI and technology to improve day-to-day work, streamline processes and support attorneys more efficiently.

This is a broad role for someone who wants more than calendar management. Alongside core executive support, you will work on documents, matter coordination, process and project management. As we scale, we are adding elite talent to this team.

Schedule: This role covers weekends only, 9am to 5pm ET.

What You’ll Do

• The partner’s day. Complex, multi-time-zone diaries: schedule, protect, and make the call when two things collide. Inboxes with judgment, not just volume: triage, surface, draft the first pass, chase what has gone quiet. Meeting packs, briefing notes, agendas, and the follow-up actions afterwards. Travel end to end, including the changes in flight and the reconciliation afterwards.

• The client-facing paperwork. Engagement letters prepared, circulated and tracked through to signature and return. Client and prospect correspondence written to a standard that reflects who we act for. Contact records and CRM entries that are accurate because you keep them that way.

• The documents. Formatting, versioning, comparison, and preparing the execution copy to firm standard. Filing that means anyone can find the document, not just you .

• Time and billing, to the flagging line. Prompting and chasing time capture. Flagging billable items, disbursements and expenses to Finance for processing. You need enough billing literacy to spot what matters. You will not be processing it.

• How you work. Anything belonging to the wider function goes through the Legal Operations intake channel rather than into your own list. You work to the team’s published response standards. You reach for AI first and tell us when you have found a faster way.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years supporting partners, senior fee earners or C-suite executives, ideally in law or professional services.

• Fluent English, verbal and written

• Strong proficiency with MS Office, Aderant or similar practice management software, PowerBI or similar data analytics dashboards, Claude, CoPilot or similar AI tools, Asana or similar project management tools

• Excellent organizational and project management skills; able to carry several workstreams without dropping detail

• Ability to remain poised under pressure, multitask, and prioritize effectively

• Strong team orientation and a preference for collaboration

• Experience with a practice management, billing, time-capture or document management system — or evidence you have learned a comparable system quickly

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

postings.descriptionText:
Somos Despegar, parte del ecosistema de Prosus, y hace más de 25 años revolucionamos la forma de viajar en América Latina ✈️. Construimos tecnología que transforma experiencias y conecta a millones de personas con sus sueños de viaje.
Buscamos talento que piense en 10x, actúe con autonomía y genere impacto real. Si te apasiona innovar, aprender rápido y construir en equipo, este lugar es para ti

¿Qué desafíos te esperan?
• Liderar procesos de proyecciones de corto y largo plazo; coordinando a distintas áreas de la compañía para lograr los inputs necesarios

• Preparación, consolidación y presentación de los principales entregables de Planning: Resultados y Proyecciones de corto y largo plazo (Budget, Forecast, Run Rate, etc.)

• Análisis de Resultados de los distintos negocios de Despegar para detección de oportunidades y amenazas

• Simplificación y automatización de procesos interno (armado planillas, presentaciones, reportería)

• Control presupuestario, detección y análisis de desvíos (Resultados reales vs. Presupuesto estimado); alertas para detección temprana de desvíos y propuesta proactiva de planes de mitigación

• Armado y exposición de presentaciones de resultados, análisis y KPIs al Board & Sr. Management

¿Qué valoramos?
• Personas graduadas o estudiantes avanzados de carreras de Ingeniería, Ciencias Económicas o afines.

• Inglés avanzado.

• Portgués (deseable).

• Conocimientos avanzados en Excel.

• Conocimientos en BI (deseable).

• Trabajo en equipo, capacidad analítica y manejo de información.

• Autonomía e Iniciativa.

• Orientación a los resultados, planificación y organización.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Autonomía real para tomar decisiones e impactar desde el día 1
Cultura de aprendizaje continuo: fallamos rápido, aprendemos y escalamos
Equipo diverso, colaborativo y sin silos
Oportunidades de crecimiento en un ecosistema global (Prosus)
Valoramos el ownership, la innovación y poner a las personas en el centro.
Viajar te transforma, trabajar en Despegar también ✈️

•
Ser dueño/a de todas las comunicaciones CRM (email, push, WhatsApp) del país que te toque.

•
Trabajar con stakeholders senior (brand managers, comercial managers, equipos de producto) para definir qué comunicar, a quién y cuándo.

•
Cruzar y analizar datos: SQL, queries, dashboards. bajar info, la cruzás, sacás insights y los traducís en acciones concretas.

postings.title: Manager — Cloud Platform (Traffic)
postings.descriptionText:
Somos Despegar, parte del ecosistema de Prosus, y hace más de 25 años revolucionamos la forma de viajar en América Latina ✈️. Construimos tecnología que transforma experiencias y conecta a millones de personas con sus sueños de viaje.

Buscamos Engineering Manager para liderar el equipo de Traffic dentro de Cloud Platform. El equipo es responsable de todo el stack de componentes de la infraestructura de tráfico: ingress, load balancing, service mesh, API gateways y todo lo que garantiza que el tráfico de nuestras aplicaciones fluya de manera eficiente, segura y escalable sobre AWS y Kubernetes. Actualmente esta infraestructura es crítica, ya que permite el funcionamiento de todo el tráfico de Despegar, aproximadamente 2k microservicios con 10M RPM, teniendo gran impacto en toda la empresa. A su vez, forma parte de la columna vertebral de Nebula, nuestra plataforma interna que abstrae la complejidad de la infraestructura para que los equipos de desarrollo se concentren en construir producto. También es responsable del stack de Secretos y Certificados: Vault, KMS.
El rol combina liderazgo de ingeniería con fuerte participación técnica, ya que no hay un Product Manager dedicado: el manager es responsable de priorizar el roadmap, dialogar con los equipos consumidores de la plataforma y balancear el esfuerzo técnico con el impacto en el negocio.

Principales Responsabilidades:
• Liderar al equipo de Traffic: 1:1s, feedback frecuente y honesto, planes de desarrollo profesional, performance reviews y crecimiento de cada colaborador.

• Asegurar el delivery del equipo con calidad, predictibilidad y operación saludable de la infraestructura de tráfico en producción.

• Proponer y ayudar en la definición de metodologías de trabajo, para mejorar la eficiencia del equipo y reducir puntos de dolor o fricción en el trabajo diario (ej: gestión de incidencias, manejo de reuniones efectivas, organización de seguimiento y progreso, estimaciones, etc)

• Participar activamente en las decisiones de arquitectura, proponer soluciones y desafiar constructivamente las propuestas del equipo.

• Definir y priorizar el roadmap con mentalidad de producto: entender las necesidades de los equipos clientes de Nebula, balancear deuda técnica vs nuevas funcionalidades y decidir qué se construye y qué no.

• Mantener comunicación activa con otros equipos de Cloud Platform y con los equipos consumidores de la plataforma.

• Gestionar incidentes productivos: ser responsable de que el equipo responda de forma correcta y oportuna, dar visibilidad y status, e impulsar postmortems y mejoras de largo plazo.

• Promover la investigación e incorporación de nuevas tecnologías que aporten valor a la plataforma (ej. nuevas versiones de service mesh, estrategias de traffic management, observabilidad de red).

• Velar por la salud técnica (deuda técnica, observabilidad, seguridad y buenas prácticas de ingeniería) de todo recurso bajo su responsabilidad, generando un marco de trabajo que de tiempo e incentive al equipo a atender estas cuestione.

• Visión estratégica: Generar junto a referentes del área backlog a largo plazo.

¿Qué buscamos?
• +2 años de experiencia como Engineering Manager liderando equipos de desarrollo.

• +5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software, idealmente en backend.

• Sólidos conocimientos en arquitecturas escalables y resilientes, sistemas distribuidos y gestión de dependencias.

• Experiencia con infraestructura en la nube, idealmente AWS (EC2, RDS, EKS).

• Conocimientos en orquestación de contenedores con Kubernetes y Docker.

• Experiencia con networking y traffic management: load balancers, service mesh, ingress controllers, API gateways, protocolos HTTP/TCP/gRPC.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación para explicar conceptos técnicos complejos de manera clara y articular con múltiples equipos.

• Espíritu propositivo para desarrollo de backlog de largo plazo y habilidades de priorización con mentalidad de producto centrado en el usuario.

• Mentalidad de owner: accountable, orientado a resultados y capaz de trabajar con alta autonomía y alto alineamiento.

• Background en diseño de microservicios y gestión de clústeres a escala.

Nice to have:
• Experiencia previa liderando equipos de infraestructura o platform engineering.

• Experiencia con tools de observabilidad de red (tracing, métricas, debugging de tráfico).

• Experiencia con estrategias de despliegue avanzadas (canary, blue-green, traffic splitting).

• Hands-on: Además de liderar al equipo, esperamos que impulsen y lleven adelante iniciativas técnicas estratégicas, participando activamente en el diseño, implementación y evolución de la plataforma.

• Exposición a entornos de alta velocidad o regionales (Tech, Scale-ups, Startups o Consumo Masivo).

postings.title: Data-AI Architect
postings.descriptionText:
Why Join dLocal?dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60+ countries across emerging markets—moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300+ teammates from 40+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.
 


What’s the opportunity?
We are looking for a Data Architect to provide the technical direction for dLocal’s data and analytics architecture. This role will shape a scalable, governed, and highly consumable data ecosystem across Data & AI and engineering—connecting domain-owned data products, real-time platforms, analytical workloads, machine-learning use cases, and business-facing data consumption.
You will act as a senior technical reference for architecture decisions, translating business and product needs into pragmatic designs that balance scalability, reliability, latency, security, interoperability, developer experience, and total cost of ownership.

What will I be doing?
•
Define and evolve enterprise data architectures, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend fit-for-purpose technology patterns across batch, streaming, lakehouse, warehouse, and operational use cases.

•
Review and advise other architects on the data aspects of their RFCs, helping ensure consistency with enterprise data principles, governance standards, and architectural direction.

•
Lead the adoption of data-mesh principles, including domain-oriented ownership, data as a product, federated computational governance, self-serve platform capabilities, discoverability, quality, and measurable data-product SLAs.

•
Establish reference architectures and engineering standards for data products, pipelines, ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, observability, lineage, security, and access management.

•
Provide oversight on operational SLAs, including latency, cost, quality, freshness, reliability, and production performance.

•
Design and govern streaming architectures using technologies such as Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, and Databricks, supporting use cases from scheduled batch through sub-second real-time processing.

•
Define reliable event-processing patterns, including schema and data contracts, schema registries, event-time processing, late-event handling, idempotency, deduplication, replay and reprocessing, dead-letter flows, and freshness SLAs.

•
Shape semantic layers and enterprise ontologies that create consistent business meaning across domains, including canonical entities, metrics, dimensions, relationships, business definitions, metadata, lineage, and versioning.

•
Establish patterns that allow semantic models to serve analytics, operational applications, machine learning, and AI use cases without creating duplicated or contradictory definitions.

•
Guide the evolution of cloud data platforms and lakehouse capabilities, including Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta/Iceberg tables, object storage, data warehouses, and BI consumption layers across AWS and GCP environments.

•
Provide architectural direction for MLOps and feature-platform capabilities, including batch and online features, model-serving integrations, low-latency data paths, model/data lineage, monitoring, and governance.

•
Lead or contribute to architecture RFCs, technical decisions, design reviews, migration plans, and implementation roadmaps; make complex trade-offs clear to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
Partner with domain teams to clarify ownership, data-product responsibilities, operational handover, quality accountability, access approval, and cross-domain consumption models.

•
Define practical controls for data quality, observability, privacy, security, resilience, cost management, and production readiness.

•
Take ownership of critical architectural issues, facilitate resolution across teams, and ensure decisions are followed through to implementation and operation.

•
Act as a trusted advisor and technical mentor to da…

What skills do I need?
•
8–10+ years of experience designing and operating scalable data architectures, preferably in complex enterprise or high-growth environments.

•
Strong experience designing and implementing data-mesh architectures and operating models, including domain ownership, data products, federated governance, self-serve platforms, contracts, quality, and discoverability.

•
Deep experience with streaming and event-driven architectures, including Kafka or Kinesis and one or more processing engines such as Flink or Spark Structured Streaming.

•
Demonstrated ability to design for real-time and near-real-time workloads, including latency measurement, event-time semantics, late data, state, deduplication, idempotency, replay, and failure recovery.

•
Strong knowledge of semantic layers, business ontologies, canonical data models, knowledge graphs or metadata models, metric definitions, and semantic governance.

•
Expertise in data modeling, data lake and lakehouse patterns, warehouse design, data pipelines, data products, metadata, lineage, and data management technologies.

•
Experience with cloud data platforms and services, particularly AWS and/or GCP; experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Iceberg, or comparable technologies is valuable.

•
Proficiency with relevant data and platform technologies such as Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Python, SQL, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and observability tooling.

•
Experience architecting or supporting MLOps, feature stores, online/offline data serving, or other low-latency machine-learning data systems.

•
Ability to establish practical frameworks for data access, stewardship, governance, privacy, security, quality, and operational accountability.

•
Strong understanding of reliability, scalability, performance, resilience

postings.title: Principal Security Engineer – Identity & Access
postings.descriptionText:
Why Join dLocal?dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60+ countries across emerging markets—moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300+ teammates from 40+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.

About Us & The Role 
We are not building a traditional, bureaucratic identity and access management function. We are building a modern, highly automated identity security program—and we need a sharp, relentless operator to build it.

Identity is the new perimeter, and managing how our global workforce accesses enterprise systems is one of our highest priorities. We are looking for a Principal Security Engineer – Identity & Access to help drive our identity evolution alongside our existing senior engineering team. You will be walking into a rapidly evolving ecosystem that has outgrown its early identity frameworks. Your mandate is to take that complex web of legacy entitlements and build a highly scalable, automated identity governance machine.

This is not an "ivory tower" strategy role. We do not need someone to draw Visio diagrams and hand them off to junior admins. We need a pragmatic, high-agency builder who helps design the strategy but has the zero-ego grit to execute it with their own hands.

What You'll Do
•
Engineer the Identity Lifecycle (JML & SoD): Take on our workforce identity and access ecosystem. You will engineer a highly automated Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) machine, implementing robust access certifications, Separation of Duties (SoD), and unified IGA frameworks that scale with our hyper-growth.

•
Federation, Zero Trust & Integration: Design and scale our authentication and authorization foundations across cloud, SaaS, and on-premise environments. You will lead identity federation leveraging SAML, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and SCIM, while driving the adoption of Zero Trust architecture and Adaptive MFA across the enterprise.

•
M&A & Enterprise Transformation: As a rapidly expanding global fintech, we acquire and scale. You will lead the identity integration strategy for mergers, acquisitions, and massive enterprise transformation initiatives, securely and seamlessly folding new organizations into our identity ecosystem.

•
Zero-Ego Execution: As a senior technical anchor on the team, you lead by example. You will get your hands dirty. You will configure the integrations, write the RBAC policies, engineer the IGA platforms, and untangle access flows yourself.

•
Codify Governance & Shift Left: You will design self-service identity workflows, automated controls, and identity KPIs that force business leaders (the first line of defense) to explicitly own and accept their access risks. You translate written compliance policies into code.

•
Be the IAM Diplomat: When you change how developers and commercial teams authenticate, there is always friction. You will be a key face of our identity transformation. You must have the extreme patience, persistence, and EQ to negotiate with engineering directors, bringing them along and enforcing security without alienating them.

What You Bring
•
Resilient Problem Solver: You don't get stuck. Where others see a messy legacy setup, you see an exciting puzzle. You don't get paralyzed or frustrated by organizational friction; you thrive on using the latest technologies and original thinking to solve long-standing identity problems.

•
Track Record Over Tenure: We do not care about arbitrary "years of experience." We care about outcomes. You must have a proven track record of designing, building, or scaling Identity and Access programs in fast-paced, complex environments.

•
Deep IGA & Protocol Expertise: You possess solid, hands-on experience with modern workforce identity systems, lifecycle processes (JML, SoD, Certifications), protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, SCIM), RBAC/ABAC models, and enterprise identity platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta).

•
Pragmatic Operator Mindset: You understand that security cannot kill velocity. You know how to find the critical balance between enforcing strict, least-privilege security and maintaining high usability for the business.

•
Disciplined Multi-Threading: You are ruthlessly organized, capable of driving an enterprise identity strategy while simultaneously troubleshooting an immediate, ground-level access escalation.

•
Force Multiplier: You elevate the engineers around you. You bring strong mentoring, leadership, and documentation capabilities, ensuring that the systems you design are highly scalable, well-understood, and easily maintained by the wider organization.

Nice to Have
•
Experience navigating the identity and access requirements of highly regulated environments (PCI-DSS, SOX, SOC 2).

•
Familiarity with machine identity governance, secrets management, and API access.

•
Relevant industry certifications demonstrating your dedication to the identity domain.

Your Cross-Functional Surface Area 
You will not work in a silo. You will partner deeply with Enterprise IT Service Desk, Application owners, Cloud Platform, and Infrastructure teams to govern access across Enterprise and Cloud. You will align with Detection & Response teams to improve identity threat visibility and automated containment, and you will collaborate heavily with HR and Enterprise Applications to ensure identity data flows securely from the ultimate source of truth.

postings.title: Staff Engineer - Java
postings.descriptionText:
Why Join dLocal?dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60+ countries across emerging markets—moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300+ teammates from 40+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.
 


We are looking for a highly skilled Staff Engineer to join our Payments Performance team. This team is focused on optimizing payment performance across multiple dimensions: improving conversion rates, maximizing take rate, and keeping fraud and operational costs under control while ensuring compliance.
As a Staff Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and evolving the systems that power critical areas such as payment routing, fraud prevention, and anomaly detection. This includes building and scaling systems that intelligently decide which processors handle each transaction, developing real-time fraud decisioning tools based on data and machine learning models, and enabling proactive detection of anomalies across business and operational metrics.
You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design robust, scalable, and high-performance systems, ensuring they meet both current and future needs. Your expertise in system design and architecture will be essential in driving technical decisions, improving our platform, and helping the team navigate complex challenges.
This role requires a strong strategic mindset and the ability to understand the broader impact of technical decisions, as you’ll be contributing directly to the evolution of one of the most critical areas of our platform.

What will I be doing?
• Collaborate with technology leaders and the product team to understand department goals and requirements, translating them into technical solutions.

• Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Java applications and systems aligned with business objectives.

• Lead the technical architecture and design of Java-based projects, ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.

• Create scalable architecture systems for Java-based applications, considering future growth and evolving business needs.

• Optimize application performance by identifying and addressing areas for improvement, such as code optimization, database query optimization, and resource utilization.

• Troubleshoot design flaws and system bottlenecks to enhance application stability and performance.

• Perform validation tests to ensure the flexibility and scalability of the Java environment, making necessary adjustments as needed.

• Conduct comprehensive system performance tests to identify bottlenecks, assess system capacity, and fine-tune application performance.

• Generate and present detailed systems reports, including performance metrics, bottlenecks, and recommendations for improvements.

• Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to maintain high standards of software development, ensuring code quality, readability, and adherence to best practices.

What skills do I need?
• Bachelor’s degree in software engineering or computer science.

• Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in Java development.

• Solid experience in Java application development and software architecture.

• In-depth knowledge of object-oriented design principles and design patterns.

• Ability to write clean, efficient, and readable code.

• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP (desired).

• Experience with Java development frameworks like Spring and Hibernate .

• Event-driven architecture design experience.

• High-level project management skills.

• Ability to solve complex software system issues.

• Good verbal and written communication skills.

• Being a team player, enjoying working with your own team and collaborating with other teams in the organization.

• Upper-intermediate written and spoken English proficiency.

• Well-versed in the software development life cycle.

• Experience with monitoring applications in production using telemetry tooling such as Newrelic, Datadog, Grafana + Prometheus, Dynatrace, CloudWatch, distributed logs like ELK, etc.

What do we offer? Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:
- Flexibility in how you work: We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.
- Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
- Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
- Work From Anywhere: Team members can work while traveling for up to 3 months every year.
 
 
What happens after you apply?
Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!
 
Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin and Youtube for more about dLocal!

Summary

También se espera que el DTM apoye instancias de consultoría de posventa cuando el cliente solicite asistencia técnica personalizada.

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.descriptionText:
Our client is an enterprise AI platform that helps critical organizations accelerate AI adoption. It combines a multi-model AI platform, local deployment teams, and expert advisors to operationalize AI across customer, employee, and back-office workflows — including support, sales, HR, legal, finance, procurement, and IT. The platform is built on a layered architecture covering infrastructure, business context, orchestration, and management, with a focus on security, compliance, scalability, and full customization. The company operates across 30+ global markets and is backed by top-tier venture firms.
 
About the Role
Maybe you are already building with Agentic AI and are frustrated by how rarely it reaches production. Or maybe you have started experimenting and know you want to work on these systems properly, not just around the edges. In this role, you will not spend your time building demos that go nowhere. You will help deploy Agentic systems into production at major enterprises, on timelines measured in weeks and months, not years.
 
What You Will Do
This is a hands-on role for high-caliber software engineers who enjoy hard technical problems, real ownership, and work that has visible impact. Every client environment is different. The expectation is the same: get it working in production.
You will work directly with customers to understand operational challenges and success criteria, translate open-ended problems into clear technical designs and implementations, own delivery of the platform and guide clients on best practice, build AI agents that integrate with customer systems, data sources, and APIs, conduct ad hoc workshops with client teams, write production-quality code to support integrations, logic, and workflows, own deployments — including reliability, performance, and continuous improvement — test with real data, measure outcomes, and iterate quickly, collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to improve the platform, and contribute to tools, documentation, and delivery practices that help the team scale.
 
Why Join
You'll be part of a fast-growing startup working on cutting-edge agentic solutions — the hottest topic in enterprise right now. You'll join a team of high-agency builders coming from top tech companies. It's a global company with a local team, and you'll be part of the founding team. The role offers a mix of home office and local client travel, along with a great salary and early-stage stock options.
 
Who You Are
Several years of professional software engineering experience, with a solid technical background as a backend engineer, full-stack engineer, or a profile close to solutions architect
Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems, and leading architecture decisions
Ability to approach software engineering as a generalist — a problem-solver who can tackle new challenges and isn't tied to a single technology
Experience integrating platforms into customer environments using APIs, cloud infrastructure, MCP, and production data flows
Comfortable working directly with customers and owning ambiguous problems; prior client-facing experience is a plus, though not required
Clear communication skills and a strong ownership mindset
Familiarity with AI / LLMs and a genuine interest in building AI-powered systems that work in practice
 
Nice to Have
Experience in forward deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing roles
Exposure to AI agents, automation, or conversational systems
Experience being part of a fast-growing startup and enjoying that pace
Familiarity with cloud environments
Experience with TypeScript, Go, or Python

postings.title: DevOps / SRE / DevSecOps Engineer (AWS) -  Latin America, Remote
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements
• 5+ years professional experience in DevOps, SRE, or DevSecOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, ALB, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, KMS, S3)

• Experience operating Aurora/PostgreSQL in production, including multi-AZ failover, read replicas, and replica lag monitoring

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)

• Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and ECS/Fargate

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

• Experience with deployment automation and tested rollback paths, including rollback drills

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, or similar)

• Experience with load testing (k6 or similar) and operating services against latency SLOs and error budgets

• Security-first mindset: experience with vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance/hardening practices

• Experience supporting SOC 2 (or similar) audit evidence and client security reviews

• Experience with incident response, on-call rotations, and root-cause analysis

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with S3 Object Lock and long-term archival for audit/compliance retention

• Experience supporting secure multi-tenant environments (e.g., PostgreSQL Row-Level Security)

• Experience supporting database migration tooling and expand/contract schema changes

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: DevOps / SRE / DevSecOps Engineer (AWS) - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements
• 5+ years professional experience in DevOps, SRE, or DevSecOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, ALB, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, KMS, S3)

• Experience operating Aurora/PostgreSQL in production, including multi-AZ failover, read replicas, and replica lag monitoring

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)

• Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and ECS/Fargate

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

• Experience with deployment automation and tested rollback paths, including rollback drills

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, or similar)

• Experience with load testing (k6 or similar) and operating services against latency SLOs and error budgets

• Security-first mindset: experience with vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance/hardening practices

• Experience supporting SOC 2 (or similar) audit evidence and client security reviews

• Experience with incident response, on-call rotations, and root-cause analysis

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with S3 Object Lock and long-term archival for audit/compliance retention

• Experience supporting secure multi-tenant environments (e.g., PostgreSQL Row-Level Security)

• Experience supporting database migration tooling and expand/contract schema changes

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: DevOps / SRE / DevSecOps Engineer (AWS) - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements
• 5+ years professional experience in DevOps, SRE, or DevSecOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, ALB, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, KMS, S3)

• Experience operating Aurora/PostgreSQL in production, including multi-AZ failover, read replicas, and replica lag monitoring

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)

• Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and ECS/Fargate

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

• Experience with deployment automation and tested rollback paths, including rollback drills

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, or similar)

• Experience with load testing (k6 or similar) and operating services against latency SLOs and error budgets

• Security-first mindset: experience with vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance/hardening practices

• Experience supporting SOC 2 (or similar) audit evidence and client security reviews

• Experience with incident response, on-call rotations, and root-cause analysis

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with S3 Object Lock and long-term archival for audit/compliance retention

• Experience supporting secure multi-tenant environments (e.g., PostgreSQL Row-Level Security)

• Experience supporting database migration tooling and expand/contract schema changes

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: DevOps / SRE / DevSecOps Engineer (AWS) - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements
• 5+ years professional experience in DevOps, SRE, or DevSecOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (ECS/Fargate, RDS/Aurora, ALB, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, KMS, S3)

• Experience operating Aurora/PostgreSQL in production, including multi-AZ failover, read replicas, and replica lag monitoring

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)

• Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and ECS/Fargate

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

• Experience with deployment automation and tested rollback paths, including rollback drills

• Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, or similar)

• Experience with load testing (k6 or similar) and operating services against latency SLOs and error budgets

• Security-first mindset: experience with vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance/hardening practices

• Experience supporting SOC 2 (or similar) audit evidence and client security reviews

• Experience with incident response, on-call rotations, and root-cause analysis

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with S3 Object Lock and long-term archival for audit/compliance retention

• Experience supporting secure multi-tenant environments (e.g., PostgreSQL Row-Level Security)

• Experience supporting database migration tooling and expand/contract schema changes

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Full Stack and Backend NodeJS TypeScript/JavaScript Engineer (Senior) - Latin America, Remote
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Requirements
• 5+ years professional software development experience (backend-focused)

• Strong professional experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript

• Experience building low-latency API services in AWS

• Experience building scalable RESTful APIs

• Experience with SDK integrations to other services

• Experience with PostgreSQL/AuroraDB, including Row-Level Security (RLS)

• Experience building secure multi-tenant environments

• Comfortable writing raw SQL and managing schema migrations (e.g., node-postgres, node-pg-migrate)

• Professional experience with React

• Strong testing practices, including integration tests against real databases and failure-mode/fault-injection testing

• Experience working with AI coding assistants as part of daily development

• CI/CD application creation and maintenance skills

• Solid understanding of full stack development, with the ability to contribute to frontend work when needed

• Substantial background working with large, complex systems

• Ability to overlap US business hours

• Bachelor's degree required

• Extreme ownership and accountability for deliverables

• Client-focused dedication to team commitments

• Best practices knowledge and adherence

• Strong problem-solving ability

• Positive mindset and can-do attitude

• Meticulous attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with append-only, event-sourced, or bitemporal data models

• Experience with Fastify and schema-first validation (e.g., Zod)

• Experience running containerized services on AWS Fargate/ECS

• Experience in compliance-sensitive or audit-heavy domains (e.g., fintech, telecom/TCPA compliance)

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

postings.title: Full Stack Laravel + React Developer - Remote, Latin America
postings.descriptionText:
Bluelight Consulting is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight Consulting. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for
• 4+ years of experience with Laravel, specifically with Laravel 8 and above.

• Experience with: Eloquent ORM, Laravel Authentication, Laravel Query Builder.

• Experience with testing tools, such as Pest PHP, PHPUnit, Laravel Dusk, Playwright.

• Experience with Inertia.js and RESTful API in Laravel.

• Experience with frontend development (React, Vue.js, Laravel Livewire, etc).

• Bonus points if you have experience with Tailwind CSS.

• Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon, both regarding estimates and the general process.

• Ability to identify with Bluelight's clients' goals and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

• A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.

• Forensic attention to detail.

Company Benefits
• Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.

• Generous paid-time-off policy

• Flexible working hours

• Work remotely

• Continuing education, training, conferences

• Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote
